name: Adam Schiff
subject: propaganda banners hanging on DC buildings
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=9021%2E5257348%2EF8lOhi ]Adam Schiff for Senate

When I was first elected to the Senate, I was determined to do things a
little differently and bring some of my oversight work to the upper
chamber.

And I wanted to share just one example:

By now, if you visit the nation’s capital, you’ve probably seen these
propaganda banners sprouting up on federal buildings. We’ve uncovered how
much these banners cost taxpayers through never-before-seen documents.

And why they’re illegal.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q32025_abs_em.sQXYU5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250925_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=9021%2E5257348%2EF8lOhi ]Donald Trump's face on a banner in D.C.

In just four months, at least three federal agencies have paid for massive
political banners with your tax dollars:

- U.S. Department of Agriculture: ~$16,400

- Department of Labor: ~$6,000

- Health and Human Services: ~$34,000

That’s at least $50,000 in taxpayer money for Trump propaganda:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q32025_abs_em.sQXYU5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250925_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=9021%2E5257348%2EF8lOhi ]Donald Trump on a banner, paid for with your tax dollars

These aren’t informational signs. They don’t explain programs, benefits,
or public services. They are giant portraits of the President. They look
like they're straight out of soviet Russia. And they are the textbook
definition of propaganda.

Since 1951, federal law has explicitly prohibited using taxpayer funds for
propaganda and self-aggrandizement.

This isn’t a gray area. It’s illegal.

And it violates the Constitution’s command that no funds leave the
Treasury except as appropriated by Congress.

Through our oversight work, my office uncovered a never-before-reported
contract for a banner at HHS that goes even further — specifying that the
propaganda banners should “last for 4 years.” In other words, until the
end of Trump’s term.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q32025_abs_em.sQXYU5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250925_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=9021%2E5257348%2EF8lOhi ]Make America Healthy Again - Building banner

This is not only a waste of taxpayer dollars. It’s also an authoritarian
tactic.

Dictators from Stalin to Saddam to Putin to Kim Jong Un have plastered
their images on government buildings to demonstrate power.

And now, the Trump Administration is doing the same in Washington.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q32025_abs_em.sQXYU5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250925_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=9021%2E5257348%2EF8lOhi ]photo of a banner of Stalin

Let’s be clear: this is not normal. It’s not lawful. And it’s not
democratic. It’s propaganda – paid for with your money.

Democracy doesn’t disappear overnight — it vanishes day by day, one
lawless act after another. Oversized portraits on government buildings
may look like vanity. But they are also a warning. We must take it
seriously.

I’m going to keep fighting to hold Donald Trump and his Administration
accountable, and your support makes my work possible.

Thanks for all you do,

Adam

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=q32025_abs_em.w4l6oI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250925_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=9021%2E5257348%2EF8lOhi ]CHIP IN

| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

clean_body: I didn't think it would end like this... | Patriot, It's never easy to admit when you're wrong. When my team told me that we might not hit our End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline, I laughed. After being a Green Beret and fighting so hard for this country's freedom, I thought this would be the easy part. I went before my team and said there was no way our grassroots supporters would let us down. When they told me to set my expectations low, I said if anyone was going to stand by us, it would be people like YOU. Unfortunately, I was wrong. We 're missing our deadline. I don't know if it's my fault or if something went wrong with our donation platform, but according to all the information I have, we are dangerously close to missing our End-of-Quarter fundraising goal. To say I was shocked would be an understatement. I really thought we could hit our target. Thankfully, we still have one last chance. My team reminded me we have a five-hour window to collect donations and make up lost ground. According to my information, we need to raise $5,922 within the next FIVE HOURS to meet our emergency deadline extension. I 'm humbly asking you, friend, can you rush a donation of $5, $10, $25, or anything you can spare so we can make up lost ground and hit our End-of-Quarter goal? | I'm counting on you and hoping you can come through for me. clean_body: This isn’t tough talk. This is reckless, dangerous poison. | Fellow American, I’m angry. You probably saw it, and if you haven’t, Jasmine Crockett sat on CNN and called President Trump a “wannabe Hitler.” Then she smirked, defended it, and called it “accurate.” This isn’t tough talk. This is reckless, dangerous poison. Think about what Crockett and her friends are saying: they voted against condemning the assassination of Charlie Kirk. Against condemning murder. While families prayed, they scoffed. While conservatives came together, they shrugged. Crockett thinks words like “Hitler” are just political seasoning. But she knows exactly what she’s doing. Stirring up the most unstable, the most violent, the most radical voices on her side — and aiming them at us. Texas doesn’t raise cowards, and I refuse to sit here while Crockett plays arsonist on live television. I will continue to fight back against her dangerous attacks. My district is a top target for these violent radical leftists, and they will do everything they can to flip this seat and take back control of Congress. So I’m asking you, fellow American: please stand shoulder-to-shoulder with me. Let them rant on cable news. Let them tweet themselves hoarse. We’ll meet their madness with action, and we’ll win. Beth Van Duyne | | PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS

Peter, My team and I have been working day and night for the last few months to stop what feels like constant attempts to dismantle and undermine our democracy. They passed an egregious racial gerrymander in Texas and Missouri. Fights in Indiana and Ohio are on deck. It’s been a hectic few months to say the least. So I want to take a step back — and talk about why they’re so desperate to rewrite the rules of the next election. **The Republicans are scared. Donald Trump is scared.** They’re worried that if the election is fair, they’re going to lose the House and their anti-democracy agenda will finally be put in check. We fight for fairness for a reason. For us, fairness is an invaluable tool. If things are fair, Democrats win. We don’t need special treatment or a leg up. We win because we have better candidates, better policies, and better ideas. [**If you’re with the NDRC in our fight for fairness, we need your support. This is an existential moment for our democracy, and what we do today will resonate for years to come. Make no mistake: Being committed to fairness does not mean being blind to reality.
This movement has a state-by-state strategy that deploys different tactics to combat unfairness in whatever form it takes. That allows our side to challenge unfair and illegal maps in the courts. We organize grassroots supporters to hold state lawmakers accountable. In California, we’re supporting responsible, temporary measures to respond to craven Republican power grabs. And throughout the country, we have kept our eyes on a 10-year plan to ensure we’re winning the most critical state-level elections for the future of our democracy.
**So even as we’re ready to push back against the new egregious gerrymanders coming down the pike, we’re also laser-focused on our long-term strategy to secure fairness. **
Because we know one thing for certain — Republicans are not going to suddenly give up and start playing fair. Texas Governor Greg Abbott swore the redistricting fight “could last years.” Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is demanding a redo of the 2020 Census to “award Florida what we’re entitled to.”
[**They’re not going to let up — so we’ve got to be ready for whatever it is they try to throw at us. subject: ICE is disappearing and killing immigrants

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Since Donald Trump took back the White House and launched his cruel
mass-deportation agenda, at least 17 people have died in ICE custody,
including:

* Two detainees who were cruelly shot and killed by a gunman at a Dallas
ICE facility yesterday.
* Silverio Villegas González, a Mexican father who was shot and killed
by an ICE agent in a Chicago suburb. DHS lied and claimed the agent
was “seriously injured” by Silverio, but body cam footage reveals the
agent said his injuries were “nothing major.”
* Former DACA recipient Ismael Ayala-Uribe, who was protected by DACA in
2012 but was denied reapplication in 2016, died from a sudden illness
while detained, after a hospital visit and surgery were delayed.

As far as we know, this is the highest rate of deaths in ICE custody in
the first six months of any year on record.

Not only are people dying in detention centers and at the hands of ICE
agents, but hundreds have gone missing.

New reporting indicates that two-thirds of the 1,800 people held at the
so-called Alligator Alcatraz center in Florida are missing in ICE’s online
database and are unable to be located by their loved ones. They have truly
been disappeared.

Justice Democrats’ Rep. Delia Ramirez is leading the call for answers and
accountability, demanding an investigation into her constituent’s death
and the widespread reports of human rights violations by ICE in our
communities and their detention centers.

In Delia’s words, “Every death at the hands of ICE, every family separated
by ICE, every orphan created by ICE is Kristi Noem’s responsibility. She
must come to the committee and account for ICE's unlawfulness.”

Let’s raise our voices and demand not only answers, but justice.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

subject: Back the Brave Men who Sacrificed for Tom Homan's Safety
disclaimer_text: Paid for by American Liberty Fund
body:
Seven veterans answered the call without hesitation. A Navy SEAL quit his job, hugged his family, and shadowed Tom for 30 days.
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvVjVKVjNuQ1VETg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP2hpZHM9bmNRb0xTV3FQdVlNOGVscw/gaNXqrg/s0hb75c0357)

| | | | [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f)
[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f) Dear Patriot,

Back in February, I told you the urgent story of how a team of veterans set aside everything to protect Tom Homan from a deadly threat when the government wouldn't.

It's worth retelling, especially now, as [**we face a tight deadline to cover final costs**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f).

**This is about real liberty—folks free to live without government interference or abandonment**.

It started with a disturbing call to a close friend and veteran on December 23rd.

Tom Homan, set to become Border Czar under President Trump, was already pushing bold plans to secure borders and deport criminal illegals. On Tucker, **Homan declared War on the Cartels before Trump was even sworn in.**

Tom called my friend for a clear reason. **A credible assassination plot against Tom had emerged, and Joe Biden's team did nothing** —leaving Tom and his family exposed.

Tom couldn’t sleep, and he’s the type of man that honestly doesn’t give a damn what happens to him – **his only concern was for his family and his wife he dearly loves**.

The Biden Admin refused to provide Tom with security, and Tom is like us. He can’t afford to spend hundreds of thousands of dollars out of his own pocket to ensure his own safety.

So, Tom did the next best thing and **called a combat veteran in our community**.

I got the next call from my friend who just got off the phone with Tom: “Shane, need you brother. Meet me and the boys at the G.”

Myself and a team of six other serious men were given the briefing and asked to set our lives aside until Inauguration Day when the Trump Admin could take over with a government protection team.

**No one hesitated.**

No one said, “let me check with work” or “let me ask my wife” (they all knew their wives would demand them to take the unpaid job – because we’d all do it for each other).

There were no second thoughts. Every man asked geared up and got to work to stand up the next morning.

The travel was non-stop.

Let me tell you, Tom Homan is a beast with unmatched energy, so we had to move faster than him with advance planning, extraction plans, etc.

No fancy equipment. No intel network**. Just hard men willing to do anything to keep a good man safe.**

But it came at a significant cost, and we have thousands of dollars in unpaid reimbursements we need to cover. [**Can you donate today and help cover the final costs?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f)

Seven veterans answered the call without hesitation. A Navy SEAL quit his job, hugged his family, and shadowed Tom for 30 days.

The squad: a Special Forces medic, three Army vets, three Marines—all pros in protection. Trackers, ex-LEO, extraction experts.

**Not fancy suits, but tough, bearded guardians who commanded respect and cleared crowds effortlessly.**

They logged over a dozen cross-country trips: advance scouts first, then Tom with the detail, plus family guards working with local cops we deeply appreciated.

Government-run, this would've bloated to hundreds of thousands monthly. **Our volunteers cut corners, but bills for travel and essentials piled up.**

Come January 20th, our SEAL delivered Tom safely to the inauguration, transferring to official protection. Job done.

But in February's appeal, we sought help for reimbursements and bonuses. [**Generous donors responded, yet a $5,720 gap lingers.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f)

Worse, one unpaid protector—a true patriot—has been footing these bills himself, straining his finances.

We must settle this in seven days. **[**Will you donate $75, $150, or any amount today to lift this burden?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f)** It's about honoring liberty-loving heroes.

Fast-forward: Tom's 2025 as Border Czar has been a triumph.

He's slashed illegal crossings by 70%, with encounters at historic lows.

Record deportations target criminals, eradicating threats and saving lives. Self-deportations surge as fear of enforcement spreads.

**ICE agents praise him as "one of their own,"** morale soaring under his 30+ years of experience.

But let's not overlook the volunteer veterans who enabled this.

That $5,720 must be paid soon. **[**Your gift of $35 or more could make all the difference—donate before the week ends.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f)**

Positive words about Tom abound this year.

From viral videos calling him a "hero crushing it" to Trump crediting him for plummeting stats, he's hailed for boosting safety without harming or stealing.

Government like Biden's breeds corruption; ALF works against it by taking on missions like this.

With urgency high, **[**please give what you can—$100 would help hugely**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e10636304/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuYW1lcmljYW5saWJlcnR5ZnVuZC5jb20vYWxmLWhvbWFuLTItbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjY/LbmNsR0xkU0RvZw/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWxmLWhvbWFuLTImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxNDI0X3dyMg/gaNXqrg/s2p6765599f)****.**

Gratefully,
Shane Cory
President
American Liberty Fund

subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zl3r0h2cmnjpnr2v3fmk32ndpi0ut1ielnuu647g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge8pr2c9h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zfl53ef8ahi4biuk1mhhb9q7j4lhdg3qhdcsg18o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge8pr2c9h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z55vu6jmrm2cbh1b2me7ussnvr06rr6ghd67chog_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge8pr2c9h2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zpad3g9fth14fd658i4p9po8fkmujgqsfvqma6f0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge8pr2c9h2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

Those who know much more about God and the Devil than I do say that this is an example of spiritual warfare. They tell me that it's meant to terrify me, to make me question myself and my own sanity. These nightmares, this evil, come just before a story OMG will be breaking that I believe will expose evil in a way we've never seen before. The story was placed on hold due to the shock and grief we've all felt for Charlie Kirk. I used to run stories by Charlie to get his feedback. I relayed our next release to Charlie before he was shot. It was the last text Charlie Kirk ever sent me. I prefer to keep the message private, but he understood the significance of the story and that it strikes at the heart of evil in our nation. I'm reluctant to "hype" stories anymore. That's not my intent. But I am asking for your help. First, I'm humbly asking for your prayers for me and OMG's staff. If you're a believer, I don't need to say anything else, other than "thank you." Secondly, . . This story was one of our least expensive to produce, and you'll see why when it comes out. But it will open the floodgates of truth, and we need to be prepared for that. This story has the potential to change the world, but that's not up to me. OMG, reports the truth, the world decides. But I would be negligent in my duties if we're not prepared to deal with a flood of high-level whistleblowers after this release. And that's where your support is needed. . Thank you again for all that you do and, as always, stay tuned. In Truth, James O'Keefe Founder and CEO O'Keefe Media Group Pop Acta Media | GOP Presidential PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Even now... it still doesn’t feel real that we lost Charlie.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziqijmf6b9krvuuop12j5895n1v10eca54e8leng_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
Friend,Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us.And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today.Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8i5563gadh3kmc1bpkaj6rfs7crvavha4rejkl0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️To give you perspective, Friend...Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z87q4nr2j6h587k537mvucl0sijmcr7p6ql5jav8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
He always believed this day would come.He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America.And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.And more beautiful than we can even describe.**Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: **✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg9ndta1qedghkfi08ts79gjdpbn92uteiqtj768_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn20em4mda6fmrf5rpsn5gdn9i0i76n9ea1109s0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpcbinj44r9geup7insb9dasqi4brld2mhj192dg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjm1vc815fritvk1sdn3tjn346kgccbvfh1giqto_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zab9i65h9b4dne66nou2k5btbh18ipks9du80qbo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3m9b56kgp4n33ji3bh992musfv5p473t7pivhh0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeocanvkr13f7piic9vhb2bjo2gp2rfirev4gn60_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
Also...**Here 's one more powerful thing you can do:**📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew -- or any young person in your life -- who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter...**Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziqms9co6pat972uah1cn9jvlmjhss6fkc860qk8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated...If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week...If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray...**Thank you.** We can never say it enough.If you've read this far, we want you to know this...**You 're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. **God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers.Charlie would have wanted you to pray first -- and if that's all you can give today, _we 're grateful._But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor...And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible.**Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---

**Make Your Gift Here**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za1rqgsg6dem423pp496a2bpm3fs36n0udtdfg5g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3ge1o34cjh2bs)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend.**God is so good.** 🙏

I would regret not giving you the chance to make a difference in the fight for our values, our freedom, and our Commonwealth. I know that I'm not alone in this fight. I know that there are thousands of conservatives like you who are willing to stand up for what's right. And I know that together, we can make a real difference.
But I need your help to make it happen. I need your contribution to help me and my team ensure we have the resources we need to spread our message and win this CLOSE and CRITICAL election![DONATE TODAY >>

## Hegseth Calls Surprise Military Meeting
Secretary of War Pete Hegseth has called the nation’s top military officers to [a surprise in-person meeting](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1urDAURlcDnZGxwUDh4jV089qUyGNf4Eb-QfadIew-mlGygtRH-vSd83FbbgY9xu2_CaBpTUuEs3gggryEqxDkK6BHMvkKAIRxsyksgoue8YkJtTiD_lq62ukVQICsQbdDP45j27Wy3rWSYKWEdhilmTpuuDTuPsjJKTXZvlc16tcan4Rqectb0UC_yruBaTDGTGrkVcfBIaXcfCaMtMPqr_SE3NgUaq93oqNU8l8l5krM53k2a_p6Wbx4JeYjeSS0pRLzDlsB2lnKDnJh-yO6DK6wX0NmUwgmvuET84YRDXvEI4MFB5HAsZ8IddbuONF7LGqoOr4Fg_59iP5U8anFdwAAAP__nIyLfA) next week in Virginia, including top officers overseeing troops in conflict zones. The purpose of the meeting was not disclosed. The order applies to officers with the rank of brigadier general or above or their Navy equivalent, along with their top enlisted advisors. About 800 generals and admirals are spread across the world. Military leaders are said to be [worried by the directive](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAUhZ9GOww_olhQTGN3pp3S7KNbYQbEwJ5jePsb7yvcbiUrWSvf9-e1vMAHfx6_IaKlPS0n3iUgEeYl1kKYa_TBE-QaEcmfx5riIrnUjE9MDssGPtSlbze7I0pULVoxamOM6IVqnR0Hs8K4r4MGofA99hvnqJUAPu1vgbL19lnjkxwEF1zIDvWu3oDTCADTYHjTc9w8pdz9Tf4kh3uo6YO5W1Nsg3VEV2nUr0bOjZzv--4quJSetpHzg9PIGTL5NeATLyRkDo-C5Fi5IP8r7E45V_Y_H3gSE1ooyY3RnaMY2my36_Yh-DKMTc-PCD58X9OPfH2s_AoAAP__ElCAqA), with some fearing the announcement of another reduction in force.

In May, the administration [ordered a 20 percent cut](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhTAQRE9jOtCyBmwXLtLQ_bQpkQNr_kYGI9h8xO0jUuQCaaYazdO8j8fwCJx4nd_DQl5iHlY6j0QitA_LdQjt18KJJezXQiS8zmNeBgRsS3AldsMUOF1DU0w-EiHpgnxtWmtt3dS6ePrW2ha6Go1prAmj7swUrY6uNVpbB1iwv9fAYVdDDTVW1Eb9GciZEILrLKgGaGLJe_WVeZUnxXTlF-3VmJci-afIdij9prBX2J_nWW05sfCY74LC_n6ksL8pCnv4i41WCXNeyxwjj7SX47ccJYBG5xwUu5-2k1PiozOqgXkJnH6R8i9PL48_AQAA__9MHHmU) to the ranks of four-star generals and admirals and 10 percent of the military’s generals and admirals.
## Former FBI Director Comey Indicted
Former FBI Director [James Comey was indicted](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQRp_G7rAA_1JQ3MZdbrulNcaDMxGYCCbx-u1X2VfY-pM-nXO-bssNKNCx_4eIln1aDjxLQGbMS7wKY74iBWLIV0RkOnaX4qKl7oU0Qg_LBhSupas36xE1tjVaNfbTNKlOtfXddv3QAmrA1Q3KeOiMMdgjwDCuXrVtTfbzJo0elFRS6QZ7366AZgQAM0yy6iRuxCk3j0QH39GHK70xNy7FOtg787NU7b9Kz5Wez_NsfPr-WHz2Ss_PFIjJlUrPLkW8BB0bOcZNQAi44yY8hIKiMDBGPFiktXB-OaZ0iMerMDmss92eJ4VAZRirTu4RKPwC8J-qva3-CQAA__-VvIXC) by a grand jury on two counts, centering on whether he lied to Congress during his Sept. 30, 2020, testimony about his handling of the original Trump-Russia probe at the FBI. Prosecutors claim Comey falsely said that day that he hadn't "authorized someone else at the FBI to be an anonymous source in news reports" regarding the FBI investigation. Comey said Thursday [he was innocent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu3CAQhp8Gd6zw-F5QpKE7aVNaLAy7swJjwZxj8faR8wrpvuLXf_vztX9ZinS8ftuEmkPeD7xqRGYse2qVsbREkdiWlhCZjpfLaQcFk1SbhHn3lmLbx87rgAg4dKj7ZVrXtR_7oXvrMMBg1945t27TOofQh2BDmLbJbU-_qI707aY2mHvVqx4eOIXhaXFbrLXbvCoxKvTEuTw-mQ5-Y4gt_2B5uJy6qN_MZxXDLwFGgLmu6_FdLWdv2y0QYCrn0gSYe5kAc-ZITO7GO1iAUdvNN4VcEhYZniQ9FXSci_zYhFW6nLBJOjw5Ri8_35XJofR42sIJDxZg1nmYplHNSi0CTFe0Py-Kkeq8iFG9kqX4rzP_19E_Gv4GAAD___8bkp4) of the charges. The indictment came a few days after Trump publicly called on Attorney General Pam Bondi to seek criminal charges against Comey, who will reportedly turn himself in on Friday. His arraignment is set for 10 a.m. on Oct. 9. ## Woman Tries to Burn Church Holding Kirk Vigil
A 35-year-old woman has been charged with [attempted arson](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ_GZB6ZHn4DgknIdtMLUY_dLNYaG3X3LDtvf-Je4dIqqVTf9-dj-cCYYv76xJ0m_V3LkumURKrEiygqrRi5HJQFM7IvGr3sCzhorRstdEvAmN5LU4Xp6cJYVzTVfTsMQ9NCW20TYd_S3VE_jGu3tk9yEDyOCMMaOiCs4nSNuRG6unbg4Hbvh3vdNyv2be8GrE3jKEQtfNONlH5R1vQuP8Q3X_YqTZvqIeb-MDAbmM_zvO2Sr87ATNm-xMB8QRmYPcedrjjZA6VYv73YbxZZSrbykoO82kSrWr8hp0j2O_K31Y0J1WIOdiO2z5fETCLWIwcDM7J9POpPPDlVPIXjjClF6XrTuK8dY_r3U__P7s8EfwMAAP__0j-Raw) of an El Paso church that hosted a vigil for Charlie Kirk last week. The attack occurred the day before the gathering. Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I've always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven't received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That's why I'm proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

# Trump furious that "dirty cop" James Comey case being handled by "crooked Joe Biden-appointed judge"
Former FBI Director James Comey, 64, was indicted by a federal grand jury on Thursday for **[allegedly lying to Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/32b281b1-aeb8-4cbf-8c19-20f2b180905c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during his September 30, 2020 testimony related to the Trump-Russia investigation, specifically regarding whether he authorized media leaks.
* **Trump 's furious response**: President Trump called Comey a "dirty cop" on Truth Social, claiming he told "a very simple, but IMPORTANT" lie with "ZERO margin of error" and must pay "a very big price," while expressing frustration that the case was assigned to a Biden-appointed judge.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/32b281b1-aeb8-4cbf-8c19-20f2b180905c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Biden-appointed judge assignment** : The case was assigned to District Judge Michael Nachmanoff, whom Biden appointed, prompting Trump to complain that Comey was "off to a very good start" with a "Crooked Joe Biden appointed Judge" handling his case.
* **Comey 's defense and surrender**: Following the indictment, Comey maintained his innocence and said his "heart is broken" for the Justice Department, while he was expected to surrender to authorities early Friday morning after the charges were announced.

# JD Vance SCOLDS Jimmy Kimmel after return to ABC
Vice President JD Vance said **[he would"love" for Jimmy Kimmel to apologize](https://substack.com/redirect/77a4a80a-15eb-4fee-a6fc-1a11b5a658d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to Erika Kirk and others he "slandered" after the late-night host returned to air following a brief suspension over his comments about Charlie Kirk's assassination.

* **Accusations of false blame** : Vance criticized Kimmel for "accusing right-wing America, conservative America, of killing Charlie Kirk" when the alleged assassin Tyler Robinson was actually "a left-wing radical," arguing that Kimmel was "apologizing for his murder" and "encouraging more of that violence to happen."

> "He [Kimmel] tries to say that he told a joke. He didn't tell a joke. He was actually accusing right-wing America, conservative America, of killing Charlie Kirk. We now know that is false. Charlie Kirk was murdered by a left-wing assassin who was radicalized by some of the rhetoric that we see coming from the far-Left."
* **Context of suspension and return** : Kimmel's show was temporarily pulled after he criticized the "MAGA gang" response to Kirk's death, claiming they were trying to portray the shooter as "anything other than one of them," with his return monologue drawing over 21 million YouTube views and averaging 6.2 million viewers.
* **Evidence of assassin 's motivation**: Utah Governor Spencer Cox confirmed that Robinson's family said he had "become more political in recent years" and disliked Kirk's views, with Cox noting Robinson was involved in "deep, dark internet" and "Reddit culture" that contributed to his radicalization.

Peter,
Here in Minnesota, we’re writing a story about how to govern like good neighbors. We’ve built one of the freest states to live your life the way you choose, and one of the best places to raise a child.
But here’s the thing: There’s no guarantee that we continue down the path of growth and progress.
It’s only month eight of this nightmare in Washington, and Trump has all but abandoned working families. He’s cut taxes for his billionaire golf buddies, stacked his Cabinet with lobbyists and industry tycoons, and sent costs in one direction: Up.

| Letter from the Chair
---
Leaders Always Needed: Step Up with the NEGOP
The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is calling for dedicated leaders--and those ready to become leaders--to shape the future of our state. Nebraska has a wealth of elected offices, ranging from Legislative Districts that require a significant commitment to boards and commissions with lighter time demands, and everything in between. These roles need passionate individuals to step forward and serve. Beyond elected positions, the NEGOP seeks leaders to drive County and State Party initiatives. In early 2026, County Conventions will elect representatives who, in turn, will choose State Party leadership at the State Convention. These opportunities are your chance to make a lasting impact.
What Makes a Great Leader? Countless books explore leadership, but here are five essential qualities we value:

1. Reluctant Leadership: Great leaders don't chase power for its own sake. They step up out of duty, driven by a desire to meet a need and serve others.
2. Servant Leadership: True leaders mentor, encourage, and uplift those around them. They prioritize the team's success over personal glory.
3. Rational Leadership: Effective leaders think critically, anticipate challenges, question processes, and craft thoughtful solutions to achieve shared goals.
4. Emotional Maturity: Confident but not arrogant, great leaders welcome constructive criticism with grace and use it to grow.
5. Principled Leadership: Anchored by strong moral, ethical, and spiritual values, these leaders act for the greater good, not for personal gain or recognition.

Why Step Up? Leadership roles are opportunities to grow, challenge yourself, and make a difference. Each new role builds on past experiences, creating a ripple effect of growth and impact. Your leadership strengthens families, communities, our state, and our nation. The NEGOP invites you to embrace the challenge. Whether you're a seasoned leader or ready to take your first step, Nebraska needs you. Join us now in seeking out elected office or at County Conventions in 2026 and beyond to shape a brighter future. Step up. Lead on.

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

I'm also excited that I have a meeting scheduled with Speaker Arch later this month to discuss these initiatives and move the NEGOP shared vision forward!

Rational Leadership: Effective leaders think critically, anticipate challenges, question processes, and craft thoughtful solutions to achieve shared goals. 4. Emotional Maturity: Confident but not arrogant, great leaders welcome constructive criticism with grace and use it to grow. 5. Principled Leadership: Anchored by strong moral, ethical, and spiritual values, these leaders act for the greater good, not for personal gain or recognition. Why Step Up? Leadership roles are opportunities to grow, challenge yourself, and make a difference. Each new role builds on past experiences, creating a ripple effect of growth and impact. [**This is nothing more than an abusive control tactic designed to intimidate people by surveilling their most private health decisions.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115964542/572048560/1824768205?sourceid=1150901&utm_campaign=26emama-0907aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNWE2NDkwMC1kZjlhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a6iHdnQ_Hjxgmxryaa28IUW-CJgcQocbq7S4iR2BqV8=&emci=0c56ad90-8599-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=f5a64900-df9a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

As my colleague Molly Duane stated last week in an article in _The Nation:_
> _"Texas extremists are mad they can't control what is happening outside their borders so they're trying to extend their extraterritorial tentacles into other states—even though that's antithetical to our system of federalism."_
The anti-abortion movement is proving that they'll stop short of nothing to completely erode access to abortion care, which is why they're pursuing this egregious and abusive tactic.

We can't afford to stop fighting. #

_Hello this is the team at GIFFORDS. As a Pennsylvania resident, we wanted to make sure you saw this important update and help us take action to stand up against the NRA. Thank you for reading._
* * *
Friend,
This is Adam Garber with CeasefirePA—one of the leading organizations working to end the gun violence epidemic in Pennsylvania. I asked the team at GIFFORDS if I could share this urgent message with you.
We just found out that the PA House is planning to **vote on a Common Agenda to End Gun Violence this Monday** that includes the four life-saving bills that we helped us pass out of the Judiciary Committee this week. And thanks to your overwhelming support, the PA House is taking these up as quickly as possible.
**Multiple legislators have told me the NRA and gun extremists are flooding their offices trying to stop these life-saving bills. Even some Democratic champs are feeling the pressure.**
[**Every legislator needs to hear right now Pennsylvanians want action on gun violence. Take 1 minute to send a message to your representative telling them to pass these lifesaving bills.**](https://act.ceasefirepa.org/a/pahouse_commonagenda_fall25/?source=em250926-2-pa&refcode2=10908.3935704.K3CeEF)
**[SIGN ON](https://act.ceasefirepa.org/a/pahouse_commonagenda_fall25/?source=em250926-2-pa&refcode2=10908.3935704.K3CeEF)**
We have just days to organize thousands of Pennsylvanians. The bills up for vote on Monday are critical:
* **Universal Background Checks** (HB 1593) closes a loophole unlicensed private sale of assault-rifles without a background check.
* **Extreme Risk Protection Orders** (HB 1859) allows the temporary removal of firearms from someone who is a clear threat to themselves or others.
* **Ban on Machine Gun Conversion Devices** (HB 1866) ends the spread of small, cheap devices that allow a handgun to fire up to 800 bullets in a minute.
* **Ban on Undetectable Firearms (HB 1099)** bans the manufacturing, sale, and possession of undetectable 3D-printed firearms.

[**Our voices can make a difference. Send a message to your representative today telling them Pennsylvanians want freedom from gun violence.**](https://act.ceasefirepa.org/a/pahouse_commonagenda_fall25/?source=em250926-2-pa&refcode2=10908.3935704.K3CeEF)
**[SIGN ON](https://act.ceasefirepa.org/a/pahouse_commonagenda_fall25/?source=em250926-2-pa&refcode2=10908.3935704.K3CeEF)**
Thank you,
Adam Garber
_Executive Director_
CeaseFirePA

name: The Democratic Party
subject: Amid the chaos
body:
Some reasons for hope in your inbox...
---
Derek, We know the news cycle has been bleak this year. Trump and his allies are doing everything they can to dismantle our democracy bit by bit — redrawing congressional maps to benefit themselves and attacking the free press. Last weekend, Trump even directly ordered his attorney general to prosecute his political rivals. **But Derek, all hope is not lost. We can — and must — stand up and fight back.** Here’s what’s happening amid the chaos: Democrats in _every corner of the country_ are winning or overperforming at record rates. We’ve won or overperformed in 45 out of 46 key elections this year in states like Iowa, Wisconsin, Arizona, Pennsylvania, and beyond. Voters across the country, in blue, red, and purple states alike, are heading to the ballot box in droves to make sure this administration knows what they think. At the DNC, we recently wrapped up our Organizing Summer initiative, having expanded our volunteer base to 41,000 volunteers and contacted 1.6 million voters nationwide. But we’re not stopping there — we recently launched our _All In On 2025_ organizing initiative to build on that momentum ahead of November’s key elections in states like Virginia and New Jersey. Every Democrat we elect right now is one more leader holding Trump and his allies accountable and preventing further destruction. Every voter we contact right now is one more person helping win key elections this year in states like Virginia and New Jersey, and one more person helping flip Congress next year. At the DNC, this is our focus: Empowering voters to speak out and head to the polls in every single state to elect Democrats who will prevent further harm in our country. name: Saikat Chakrabarti
subject: New poll that shows I can beat Nancy Pelosi
body:
We just got a new poll with some incredible results.

| | | | | [|
---](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=3802884d06&e=bf17056ae8)
| | | | | | Dear Friend,I've got some incredible news: We just [released a poll](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=41f622794d&e=bf17056ae8) showing that 69% of San Francisco voters don't want Pelosi to run again, including 62% of those who voted for her in the past. 84% said it's time for a new generation of Democratic leaders. After hearing positive and balanced bios of Pelosi and me, I am beating Pelosi by 6%![**Part of getting my message out is winning media respect and attention. A donation from you before Tuesday's FEC reporting deadline will really help do that. Will you celebrate this milestone with me by pitching in $3 or even $1?**](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=5ffbc35905&e=bf17056ae8)
---
| | | | | [Donate ](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=3a48b29401&e=bf17056ae8)
---
| | _(We use ActBlue for donations. ActBlue does not sell or trade your data. Neither will I — ever.)_[**The key is to show momentum on the heels of this amazing poll result.**](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=683cef3ef5&e=bf17056ae8) This poll shows that our theory of the campaign is correct: when people hear our message, we win. We’ve spent the past several months hosting hundreds of virtual town halls, knocking on tens of thousands of doors, and talking to voters at dozens of community events and in their homes. Hundreds of volunteers have come door knocking to help spread the word. We have the energy and resources to make sure every voter in San Francisco hears our message. That’s why we will win this race. But the media will mostly ignore all that. They’re just going to keep asking the same questions: “How are you polling?” (We have a great answer now!), and, “How many donors are in your FEC report?”You signed up for my campaign, which is how I know you agree with me that the Democratic Party needs new leaders. I've been a San Franciscan since 2009. I decided to run for Congress when I heard my representative, Nancy Pelosi, say that Democrats shouldn't have done anything differently in the 2024 elections, and that we had to wait "six or seven months" for Democrats to start fighting MAGA. I worked on Bernie’s presidential campaign in 2016. I was AOC's first chief of staff in Congress after serving as her campaign manager. I built her congressional office and put out the Green New Deal with her. I saw what a difference even one person can make when they are not afraid to lead. In this election cycle, dozens of Democratic challengers will defeat entrenched incumbents and party leaders. I'm looking forward to working with all of them to not only show what real resistance looks like, but real leadership.I have not sent you a single fundraising email since I launched my campaign in February. I haven’t made a single fundraising call. That's partly because I had the extreme good luck of helping to start a successful San Francisco company called Stripe. And I’ll be putting my own money into this campaign to make sure we are competitive with Pelosi. But a donation of any amount from you will show the pundits that this race has your backing, which in our system makes a huge difference.I hate that our system requires millions of dollars to run a serious campaign. It forces many candidates to spend most of their day on the phone with rich people. That changes their perspective and puts them in a subservient position. As a first-generation immigrant from Fort Worth, Texas, and as a winner of the Silicon Valley lottery, I've seen America's extreme inequality from both sides. That's why I'm running to pass a wealth tax of 2% on assets over $50 million. That's not the kind of proposal a big donor wants to hear about in a fundraising pitch. And that’s not all. I'm also running to pass Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, universal childcare, tuition-free public colleges, a ban on congressional stock trading,_**and to end the genocide in Gaza by stopping weapons and aid to Israel.**_ All of these positions are extremely popular with voters — but not with donors. That’s a big reason they don’t happen. But if I can go to Congress with a team of people who are not bought out, I believe that we can make a difference. And I promise you that I’ll fight tirelessly to make that happen. Thank you, Saikat ChakrabartiPS: [Here’s a link to that poll.](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=3a002cee3c&e=bf17056ae8)

name: Tracey Mann
subject: Make no mistake, this fight is far from over
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mann for Congress, Inc
body:
Help us deliver for President Trump and the American People. | | |
---
| |
---
| **Dear Kansan,**

These past few months have reminded us how precious — and how fragile — our freedoms truly are.

The tragic assassination of Charlie Kirk has shaken our nation. Charlie was a fearless voice for conservative values and a tireless defender of free speech, faith, and the American way of life. His loss is heartbreaking — and it’s a solemn reminder of what we’re up against.

But even in mourning, we cannot retreat.

>From day one, President Trump has brought strength and stability back to the White House. And now, the results are undeniable. After four years of chaos and decline under Joe Biden, the American people are seeing real leadership — and it’s making a difference.
* Congress just passed the **One Big Beautiful Bill** — delivering sweeping tax relief for working families, cutting wasteful spending, securing our elections, and rolling back Washington overreach.
* We’re seeing **real enforcement at the border** — new barriers, stronger security, and a return to law and order.
* The **economy is rebounding with confidence**. Jobs are returning, small businesses are breathing easier, and investment is growing once again.
* And here in Kansas, people are feeling it — **lower gas prices, safer communities** , and a renewed sense of hope for the future.

But make no mistake: **this fight is far from over**.

The radical Left hasn’t gone anywhere. In fact, recent events prove just how far some are willing to go to silence those who stand for truth. They’re still entrenched in Washington, scheming to roll back every one of our hard-won victories. And they are counting on us to be discouraged, distracted, or divided.

We won’t be.

Now more than ever, we must press forward — not just to honor Charlie’s legacy, but to secure the future he believed in. With President Trump leading the charge and conservatives gaining ground in Congress, we have a real opportunity to reshape this nation for the better.

But we can’t do it without your help.

**Will you chip in today — before the end of the month — to help us defend this momentum and keep fighting for a freer, stronger, more secure America?** Every dollar goes toward supporting President Trump’s agenda and standing up to the radical Left.

You can ([Click Here](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=b9d4747cde&e=a9d1410029)) or visit my website at [www.traceymann.com](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=d1aa5f711f&e=a9d1410029) to learn more or contribute online.

**Let’s make this comeback permanent — and let’s do it together, for Charlie, for Kansas, and for America.**

**Yours in the fight,**

Tracey Mann

P.S. I do not serve in Congress to be a caretaker in the slow demise of America. I serve to fight and work to make our country stronger. With President Trump back in the White House, we have a real chance to do just that. Please donate today to join us in the fight.

Give me just a moment to explain why I’m asking for your donation today.
#
Peter, we’re about to face the first significant test of our campaign’s financial strength.
At the end of this month, we will be filing the first of our quarterly fundraising reports with the FEC.
You know what this means by now: Our opponent and his national Republican allies will soon see how much we’ve raised — they’ll see any drop in our fundraising numbers as evidence of weakness, and they’ll determine what they need to spend against us this fall and beyond based on that number.
**[Our end-of-quarter online goal is $555,000, and I’m reaching out personally to ask if you can start us off by splitting a donation of anything that is right for you between my team and State Democrats Committee today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95976?refcode=em20250926-9490&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9490%2E614464%2E8ozNb1)**
In recent weeks, the RNC made moves to start directing funds to our opponent even earlier than usual. This comes as no surprise — we’ve long known that our race could become the _most expensive_ U.S. Senate contest in history. The GOP is ready to commit any amount to defeating us.
The GOP machine can try to buy this seat, Peter, but I know that we can defeat them by standing together. **After all, we’ve won some of the toughest races in North Carolina before.**
**[One of the most important ways you can help show that we have what it takes to win is by donating before our end-of-quarter deadline. We need to show that we’re bringing more supporters onto our team than our opponent and that our momentum continues to grow. We are launching our **End-of-Quarter Fund** with a goal of raising $150,000. And every single gift will be MATCHED dollar-for-dollar — meaning that together, we can raise $300,000 to the campaigns of Democratic pro-choice women who are already showing us the way forward.

Why is this so important? Because there's never been such a thing as an "off year" at EMILYs List. In just two months, women we've endorsed are on the ballot in must-win races. These candidates are at the very center of our fight to take back power — and they need our community behind them now more than ever.

[**DOJ Records Requests Head to Court**]()**By Justin Riemer, President, USGI** In recent months, the Department of Justice has written to most states and some localities requesting they disclose their statewide voter registration lists and other records. Many have balked, citing state and federal privacy laws as a basis to withhold voters’ personal information, including social security and driver’s license numbers. Predictably, the issue has moved to the courts who will likely define DOJ’s authority to obtain the records. Just yesterday, DOJ sued [California](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=4ff35f5b2f&e=c16f400a56), [Michigan](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1278b726f5&e=c16f400a56), [Minnesota](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=728d952805&e=c16f400a56), [New York](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=e5b0d95e4f&e=c16f400a56), [New Hampshire](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8737ff7504&e=c16f400a56), and [Pennsylvania](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=614074c16e&e=c16f400a56) for refusing to comply. This follows similar suits last week against [Oregon](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=c2ea82cfcc&e=c16f400a56) and [Maine](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=78967078b1&e=c16f400a56) and California’s [Orange County](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=6aa4b78e48&e=c16f400a56) in June for its refusal to provide records regarding noncitizen registrants.
A South Carolina voter also [sued](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=d7776efc92&e=c16f400a56) in local court last month to block the state from disclosing her “personal information” to DOJ. The court granted emergency relief before the state was even served and could respond, but the state Supreme Court recently [reversed](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1564802c2b&e=c16f400a56) the lower court. The litigation remains pending. There is also a similar suit in [Nebraska](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=c7761a9e15&e=c16f400a56). At issue is DOJ’s authority to obtain records under the Civil Rights Act (“CRA”) and National Voter Registration Act (“NVRA”) to enforce federal voting laws. A CRA [provision](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8da580f6f4&e=c16f400a56) requires officials to maintain and disclose election records to the Attorney General upon request. The NVRA has a records disclosure [provision](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=bbd4215258&e=c16f400a56) for the public to assess state compliance with the law’s voter roll maintenance and registration requirements. The NVRA provision has been heavily litigated, and courts have increasingly preempted state policies that restrict public access to information such as birth dates. Although courts have read in some privacy protections, the NVRA only explicitly permits withholding records regarding a registrant’s “declination to register to vote” and the registration agency (e.g., DMV) through which the voter registered. Courts have also not determined whether states could withhold this information from the federal government, only private entities making requests. The CRA’s preemptive effect on state privacy laws is unknown as courts have rarely addressed this provision since the 1960s. However, the law seems to assume that states would provide DOJ with sensitive information because the law [limits](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=867bc8ea36&e=c16f400a56) DOJ in re-disclosing records and has no explicit provisions authorizing redactions. DOJ's requests also implicate the federal Privacy Act, but that law does not permit private enforcement. To the extent the Act poses a bar to accessing records, DOJ would likely overcome it by checking the requisite procedural boxes. With eleven lawsuits underway and more likely, this is shaping up to be a marquee issue in an already loaded election litigation docket.

**Alaska**
* A [new ballot initiative](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=fb0c5a2e3d&e=c16f400a56) would insert the word “only” into state election law to clarify that **only** U.S. citizens may vote.

**California**
* Republican leaders are pushing a proposed [2026 voter ID initiative](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=e6dad62f3e&e=c16f400a56). The measure would require voters to present government-issued ID at the polls or to provide verified ID numbers, such as a driver’s license number or last 4 digits of a social security number, when voting by mail. The proposal would also mandate stricter voter roll maintenance. Reform California, the group supporting the effort, has raised $1.5 million and recruited over 10,000 volunteers. The group plans to collect 1.25 million signatures by mid-March to qualify for the ballot.

**Idaho**
* [ Eleven individuals](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=033d3707bb&e=c16f400a56) have now been charged with illegal voting in the May 2023 local election regarding a lodging tax. The proposal failed with 207 votes against and 198 in favor.

**Indiana**
* After a bill passed by state legislators, the state is assessing whether to [establish vote centers](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=83610f1a65&e=c16f400a56) in all 92 counties, an idea that would let voters cast ballots at any polling place instead of being tied to their own precincts. Local boards have already rejected similar ideas in places like Hamilton County.

**Michigan**
* Following a public hearing in July, the Department of State adopted a [new rule](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=b6916acf83&e=c16f400a56), following the introduction of early voting and early voting pollbooks, requiring that electronic pollbooks maintain a secure live connection to the state’s Qualified Voter File (QVF) during voting, whenever internet access is available. Pollbook software downloads will still be required as a backup to the live connection.

**Nevada**
* During a recent statewide cyberattack that knocked many state services offline, [the state’s centralized voter registration and election systems](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=6ce2898d12&e=c16f400a56) remained fully operational. That resilience is largely credited to a 2021 law requiring a “top-down” election architecture, which is isolated from other state systems and designed with modern cybersecurity practices.

**New Hampshire**
* [House Bill 317](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=a0d8aff0e9&e=c16f400a56) would require every in-person voter to show a physical photo ID or other identifying documentation, even when poll workers already know the voter by sight or relationship.

**South Carolina**
* The State Election Commission has removed [Executive Director Howard Knapp](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=9cf8e7c771&e=c16f400a56), saying they wanted new leadership. The move is not related to any election misconduct, but Knapp is still under a Law Enforcement Division investigation for alleged misconduct raised in 2024.

**Texas**
* The Dallas County Republican Party has [voted to hand-count every ballot cast](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=3e146fe5f4&e=c16f400a56) on Election Day for their March 3 primary, and chose not to participate in Dallas County’s voter program. The party will have to provide enough workers for the polls for election day, as this is the only day the change will take effect.

**Virginia**
* Gov. Glenn Youngkin has [signed Executive Order 53](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=fe260262b7&e=c16f400a56) to enhance election security. The order tightens voting system standards, requires coordination with federal agencies (including using DHS’s SAVE database to flag non-citizens), adopts updated federal voting system guidelines (VVSG 2.0), and mandates a statewide election-preparedness exercise before early voting begins.

**Wisconsin**
* [ A bill in the legislature](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=eb3aa77f6c&e=c16f400a56) would let poll workers begin processing absentee ballots on the day before Election Day. The proposal is bundled with stricter rules for drop-boxes and bans on curing ballot errors.

**Connecticut** Post-Election ReviewComment deadline: September 27, 2025
The [proposed regulation](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=36c7394725&e=c16f400a56) establishes procedures for post-election review of candidate committees after general elections, primaries, and special elections. It sets eligibility criteria, defines the weighted random-selection process, outlines audit completion timeframes, and requires notice and transparency. The regulation implements Chapters 141, 155, and 157 of the Connecticut General Statutes, as amended by P.A. 25-26.
**Georgia**[ Discussed on September 24, 2025](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=266507d347&e=c16f400a56) at State Election Board MeetingProposed Elections Division Rules and Rule Amendments 1\. Repeal of Rule 183-1-15-.012\. Changes to Rule 183-1-15-.02 Definition of Vote3\. Changes to Rule 183-1-12-.11 Conducting of Elections4\. Changes to Rule 183-1-12-.01 Conducting of Elections
The proposed rule changes are based on petition and discussed by petitioners on September 24, 2025. The rule text is currently unavailable.
**Illinois** Registration of Voters (26 Ill. Adm. Code 216)
The State Board of Elections [adopted rules](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8460074f24&e=c16f400a56) to establish the state’s automatic voter registration program under Sections 1A-16.1, 1A-16.2, 1A-16.5, and 1A-16.7 of the Election Code. These rules implement statutory requirements, create the framework for electronic voter registration, and promote administrative efficiency while protecting both the integrity of the system and the privacy interests of the Board.
**Minnesota** A number of pending rule changes[Public hearing](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=6d582656fc&e=c16f400a56) requires 25+ written requests to have a meeting on October 10, 2025.
The Secretary of State is proposing [amendments to rules](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=137f10c0c5&e=c16f400a56) governing election administration. The proposed rules modify language related to voter registration; ballot formatting and instructions; absentee ballot administration; ballot safeguard procedures; mail balloting procedures; testing of voting systems; and election official training.
**Montana** Paid Signature GatherersHearing: October 3, 2025Comment Deadline: October 10, 2025
[Montana’s proposed rule](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=080ca00af6&e=c16f400a56) would regulate ballot initiative petition signature gatherers by requiring them to register with the Secretary of State's Office, submit identifying information, and disclose their role as a gatherer in order for their collected signatures to be counted.
**New Mexico** Election audit and recountComment Deadline Closed: September 4, 2025Hearing: September 5, 2025
[Amendments](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=83c494d9e4&e=c16f400a56) include specifying that a district judge should be present for the opening and closing of ballot boxes during a voting system check, and further clarify that a New Mexico State Bar member may serve as a judge’s designee. Amendments also affirm that a district judge must witness all ballot movement during a recheck and a recount, and clarify that a New Mexico State Bar member may serve as a judge’s designee. Additional changes remove an “in-lieu of absentee” reference as it refers to an outdated category of ballots and remove “district judge” as a participant permitted to tabulate ballots during a recount or recheck.
**Virginia** Ranked Choice Voting (1 VAC 20-100)
[These adopted amendments](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=03224884d3&e=c16f400a56) create new ranked choice voting (RCV) regulations definitions, including the batch elimination process of candidates that are mathematically impossible to be elected during the RCV tabulation process. This amendment is in the final stage of adoption and is in the Governor’s office.
**Washington** Voter signature challenged, then voter can vote provisional ballotComment Deadline: October 6, 2025
[Proposed rules](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1ba11fe671&e=c16f400a56) to strengthen ballot signature “cure” procedures. County auditors must quickly notify voters of rejected signatures using multiple contact methods and give them options to fix issues before certification. The rule sets deadlines, requires additional outreach if voters don’t respond, and mandates detailed record-keeping.
**Wisconsin** Uniform Instructions for Absentee VotingThis rule was approved by the Governor on August 21, 2025.
[Rule](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8ceda97c88&e=c16f400a56) requires municipal clerks to use the unaltered, Commission-approved Uniform Instructions with all absentee ballots, ensuring voters receive consistent and legally compliant guidance. Clerks may still add local details, such as office hours, as long as they do not conflict.

**Alabama**
_**Alabama State Conference of the NAACP v. Marshall**_**, No. 2:24-cv-420 (N.D. Ala.)**
The Eleventh Circuit [heard oral arguments](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8844e24d84&e=c16f400a56) on September 23 regarding an Alabama law prohibiting assistance of voters in obtaining absentee ballot applications.
**Arizona**
_**American Encore v. Fontes**_**, No. 2:24-cv-01673 (D. Ariz.)**
On September 26, the Ninth Circuit [overturned](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=3ea1be9160&e=c16f400a56) an injunction against an election rule directing the secretary of state to discard a county’s votes if its supervisors fail to canvass the county’s results by the deadline to certify the statewide vote. In the same ruling, it upheld an injunction expanding the definition of voter intimidation to actions like “aggressive behavior” and “using threatening, insulting or offensive language.”
_**Mi Familia Vota v. Fontes**_**, No. 2:22-cv-00509 (D. Ariz.)**
On September 22, the Ninth Circuit [denied](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=95e6cec5e8&e=c16f400a56) en banc rehearing after previously upholding a lower court’s decision to block a state law requiring new federal form registrants to provide documentary proof of citizenship to vote in presidential elections or to vote early by mail.
