**Florida**
_**Florida Rising Together v. Byrd**_**, No. 6:24-cv-1682 (M.D. Fla.)**
On September 16, a federal district court [dismissed](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=a48c96e673&e=c16f400a56) a case challenging Florida’s voter registration verification procedures requiring officials to match applicants’ identifying information against government records. [Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections PAC](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=d408ff2bc4&e=c16f400a56) (“RITE PAC”) supported the intervention of the Republican Party of Florida and the Republican National Committee also intervened in the suit.
_**Florida Decides Healthcare v. Byrd**_**, No. 4:25-cv-211 (N.D. Fla.)**
On September 9, the Eleventh Circuit [upheld a Florida law](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=5aa23373d7&e=c16f400a56) that restricts who can gather signatures for citizen-led ballot initiatives, reversing a lower court’s order. The measure bars non-U.S. citizens and non-Florida residents from gathering petitions, shortens the deadline for submitting collected signatures from 30 days to 10, limits petition forms collected by a non-registered petition circulator to 25, and imposes fines or felony charges depending on the violation.
**Georgia**
_**VoteAmerica v. Raffensperger**_**, No. 1:21-cv-01390 (N.D. Ga.)**
On September 8, [a federal district court](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=633a921e18&e=c16f400a56) upheld a law which prevented distribution of pre-filled absentee ballot applications to voters, including blank applications to any resident who had already requested an absentee ballot. The court reasoned that there were “interrelated compelling governmental interests” in the Secretary of State’s concern with their use.
**Illinois**
_**Bost v. Illinois State Board of Elections**_**, No. 1:22-cv-02754 (N.D. Ill.)**
This case challenges an Illinois law permitting mail-in ballots to be received up to fourteen days after Election Day. The U.S. Supreme Court is currently weighing whether plaintiffs have standing to challenge the law. On September 22, the U.S. Supreme Court [granted](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=b1c77d225b&e=c16f400a56) the Solicitor General leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae.
**Louisiana**
_**Callais v. Landry, No. 3:24-cv-00122 (W.D. La.)**_
This lawsuit challenges Louisiana’s 2024 congressional map following the state’s implementation of a federal district court order mandating the creation of a new map with two majority-black districts. On September 24, the U.S. Department of Justice filed a supplemental [amicus brief](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=917226f37c&e=c16f400a56) in the U.S. Supreme Court in support of plaintiffs, arguing that Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act cannot constitutionally require race-based districting. The Court will hear oral argument on October 15.

_**California v. Trump**_**, No. 25-cv-10810 (D. Mass.)**
On September 17, a federal district court [denied](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=6d7276f974&e=c16f400a56) the Trump administration’s request to dismiss a challenge to its executive order on election administration.

_**RNC v. Benson**_**, No. 1:24-cv-00262 (W.D. Mich.)**
On September 25, the Sixth Circuit [affirmed](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=9635365d88&e=c16f400a56) the district court’s dismissal of this lawsuit brought by the Republican National Committee challenging Michigan’s voter roll maintenance practices.
**Missouri**
**Congressional Redistricting Lawsuits**
Missouri’s new congressional map faces [multiple recent legal challenges](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=5941a359ff&e=c16f400a56) to its constitutionality. NAACP had previously sued in early September regarding the special legislative session to redraw prior to the 10-year census period.
**Nebraska**
_**Common Cause v. Evnen**_**, No. D02C1250003301 (Neb. Dist. Ct., Lancaster Cnty.)**
On September 22, an activist group and a voter [sued](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1a66fb0eba&e=c16f400a56) to block Nebraska from disclosing voter registration data to the U.S. Department of Justice.
**South Carolina**
_**Crook v. South Carolina Election Commission**_**, No. 2025-CP-09-00195 (S.C. Ct. Com. Pleas. Calhoun Cnty.)**
On September 11, the South Carolina Supreme Court [ruled](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=c44eb620c0&e=c16f400a56) that the state Election Commission could immediately proceed sharing voter data with the U.S. Department of Justice, reversing a decision issued by a lower court in early September.
_**League of Women Voters of South Carolina v. Alexander**_**, No. 2024-001227 (S.C. 2024)**
On September 17, the South Carolina Supreme Court [held](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=3cccc86404&e=c16f400a56) that partisan gerrymandering claims in South Carolina present a nonjusticiable political question.
**Utah**
_**League of Women Voters of Utah v. Utah State Legislature**_**, No. 220901712 (Utah Dist. Ct., Salt Lake Cnty.)**
On September 15, the Utah Supreme Court [rejected](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=0fd6dc964d&e=c16f400a56) the legislature’s bid to pause the redistricting process amid an ongoing challenge to its congressional map and repeal of a 2018 ballot initiative that created an independent redistricting commission.
**Vermont**
_**Morin v. City of Burlington**_**, No. 24-cv-02403 (Vt. Super. Ct., Chittenden Unit, Civ. Div.)**
This [lawsuit](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=d16e4422a8&e=c16f400a56), filed by Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE) and the Republican National Committee on behalf of two Vermont voters, challenges a charter provision for the City of Burlington granting noncitizen residents the right to vote in school board elections. The Vermont Supreme Court will hear oral argument on October 15.
**Wisconsin**
_**Ayodabo v. City of Madison**_**, No. 2025-cv-003082 (Wis. Cir. Ct., Dane Cnty.)**
Legal group Law Forward has filed a [class action](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=152c38522c&e=c16f400a56) against the City of Madison, alleging city officials refused to count 193 properly submitted absentee ballots from the November 2024 election. The lawsuit argues that officials missed multiple opportunities to correct the oversight before certification and seeks compensatory and punitive damages for the 193 voters.

* Comments are due by October 20, 2025 for the America First Legal Foundation’s [petition](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=29cebe7c1b&e=c16f400a56) with the Election Assistance Commission, which requests changes to EAC regulations and the National Mail Voter Registration Form to mandate documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections.

---
|
---
| |

* [The Voting Wars: Public Opinion About Battles Over Voting Rules](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1f626b35a2&e=c16f400a56) looks at how partisan ideologies differ in how they approach election policy debates. Democrats tend to favor permissive laws, prioritizing higher turnout. Republicans, by contrast, are more likely to point to concerns over fraud when supporting voting restrictions. The authors argue that bridging divides on election policy will require finding shared ground across these fundamentally different belief systems.

* “Election official turnover has been increasing steadily over the past 25 years, reflecting the growing complexity and demands of election administration. The Bipartisan Policy Center released a [report](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=57df295720&e=c16f400a56) in 2024 showing that turnover rose from 28% in 2004 to 39% in 2022.”

* Wisconsin voters overwhelmingly approved a constitutional amendment in 2024 limiting voting rights to U.S. citizens. A [new policy brief](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=f77496b060&e=c16f400a56) calls for an audit of the state’s voter rolls to ensure compliance, safeguard lawful voters, and boost public trust in elections.

---
|
---
| |

* [On _Protecting Your Vote_](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=35ee752bac&e=c16f400a56) , Christian Adams talks with Ken Blackwell, former Ohio Secretary of State. Their conversation spans Blackwell’s long record of public service, the lessons learned from decades of work in the election field, and the responsibilities citizens carry in preserving democracy. Looking ahead to America’s 250th birthday, they also explore both the obstacles and opportunities facing the nation.

---
|
---
| |

* As discussed above, the Department of Justice brought lawsuits against several states [yesterday](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=5a205d57fb&e=c16f400a56) and [last week](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=53248c3184&e=c16f400a56) for failing to disclose requested voter records. This list is expected to grow, underscoring a growing flashpoint in election administration.

clean_body: Election News Update from the Grant Institute | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [DOJ Records Requests Head to Court]()By Justin Riemer, President, USGI In recent months, the Department of Justice has written to most states and some localities requesting they disclose their statewide voter registration lists and other records. Many have balked, citing state and federal privacy laws as a basis to withhold voters’ personal information, including social security and driver’s license numbers. Predictably, the issue has moved to the courts who will likely define DOJ’s authority to obtain the records. Just yesterday, DOJ sued , , , , , and for refusing to comply. This follows similar suits last week against and and California’s in June for its refusal to provide records regarding noncitizen registrants. A South Carolina voter also in local court last month to block the state from disclosing her “personal information” to DOJ. The court granted emergency relief before the state was even served and could respond, but the state Supreme Court recently the lower court. The litigation remains pending. There is also a similar suit in . At issue is DOJ’s authority to obtain records under the Civil Rights Act (“CRA”) and National Voter Registration Act (“NVRA”) to enforce federal voting laws. A CRA requires officials to maintain and disclose election records to the Attorney General upon request. The NVRA has a records disclosure for the public to assess state compliance with the law’s voter roll maintenance and registration requirements. The NVRA provision has been heavily litigated, and courts have increasingly preempted state policies that restrict public access to information such as birth dates. Although courts have read in some privacy protections, the NVRA only explicitly permits withholding records regarding a registrant’s “declination to register to vote” and the registration agency (e.g., DMV) through which the voter registered. Courts have also not determined whether states could withhold this information from the federal government, only private entities making requests. The CRA’s preemptive effect on state privacy laws is unknown as courts have rarely addressed this provision since the 1960s. However, the law seems to assume that states would provide DOJ with sensitive information because the law DOJ in re-disclosing records and has no explicit provisions authorizing redactions. DOJ's requests also implicate the federal Privacy Act, but that law does not permit private enforcement. To the extent the Act poses a bar to accessing records, DOJ would likely overcome it by checking the requisite procedural boxes. Dear Friend, I was planning to write and tell you all about our incredible August 16th **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** **DAY** event at the Library of Congress to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”But then the reports started coming in from parents and grandparents across the country about the opposition they faced at their **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** events. Friend, I know the mainstream media won’t spend a second telling you what happened so I will.In Cuyahoga, OH, protestors formed an intimidating gauntlet at the entrance to the public library. Parents had to shepherd their children through it as if they were criminals just to get into our event. Then inside, while BRAVE families were hearing books about Godly virtues, protestors held up their own inappropriate books showing pornographic content, including one depicting sexual acts between two men.In Highlands Ranch, CO, a group of grandparents invited a local deputy to read the BRAVE book, _The Test of Lionhood_ which teaches children the importance of courage, perseverance and masculinity. When the unhinged atheists at the _Freedom from Religion Foundation_ got wind of the grandparents’ effort to share these virtues with Colorado children, they fired off a threatening letter to the Sheriff’s Department.

Leave ours alone.”Friend, what on earth has happened to parents in our country? Like me, you remember a time when EVERY parent’s goal was to shelter their children from the evils of this world.And parents felt blessed to live in America where they had the very best chance of protecting their children from want, depravity, and danger.But radical leftist parents want their children exposed to transgenderism, LGBTQ lifestyles, DEI, climate hysteria, Marxism, atheism, and all the rest.Friend, you can see our work to shelter children from these dangerous ideas has never been more important.The protests against our wholesome SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY make it clear -- our work is getting under the Left’s skin.That means we’re making a difference, and we must keep going. SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY can’t be a once-a-year event.That’s why my friends at BRAVE BOOKS are making SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY a year-round movement in public libraries and schools. Friend, just look at the impact patriots like you have had on our SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY event at the Library of Congress where we partnered with President Trump’s new Center for Faith at the Department of Education.Thanks to the critical support from patriots like, we sent a loud and clear message: All of America’s children deserve to know about God’s goodness, America’s greatness, and timeless Christian values. In short, it was a Saturday like you remember filled with reading books, silly jokes, and giggles. | | Even Iggy the iguana from our BRAVE TV show, Iggy and Mr. Kirk, made an appearance much to the delight and squeals of our young audience. In short, it was a Saturday like you remember filled with reading books, silly jokes, and giggles. | | And wow – the Library of Congress – the world’s largest library – built with an unapologetic nod to our Creator. The Main Reading Room features a statue of Moses holding the Ten Commandments. The Giant Bible of Mainz and the Gutenberg Bible are on display.And engraved in stone is Micah 6:8: “What doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.” I wish some of those leftist protestors would have come to the Library of Congress and seen with their own eyes that our Founding Fathers clearly wanted Americans pointed to truth, mercy and morality.Instead, we must keep doing everything we can to bring that message to them through BRAVE Books. And that starts with making SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY a year-round movement.For your family, for America’s families, and for all the children who have little hope of hearing that God loves them and that America is good unless we reach them... Together, we’re on a mission to help parents raise good and Godly children and we’re so happy you’re with us. | | Thank you! Kirk Cameron P.S. Friend, the protests at our SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY events tell me one important thing... to beat the Left and stop them from pouring dangerous lies into our children and grandchildren’s hearts, we’ve got to keep pushing back. name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: The relentless pursuit of power
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
Donate to stop the attacks on our democracy
|
---

Peter —
It’s not often you can look around and realize you are living through a pivotal moment in American history.
But here we are.
The very foundations of our democracy — fair representation, good-faith debate, the rule of law — are being chipped away right before our eyes. And it’s all in service of politicians’ relentless pursuit of power.
**From Missouri to Texas, anti-democracy forces are trying to tip the scales of our democracy because they know Americans want something different than what they’re getting now.**
They know they’ve violated the will of the people they serve — and if it’s left up to the voters, they’ll lose their political power. But rather than change their approach to governing, rather than work on delivering real results for their constituents, they’re instead trying to manipulate the rules to help them cling to power.
That’s not leading. **It’s cheating.**
When you ask most Americans, they’ll tell you it’s wrong and shouldn’t be allowed. But it’s clear that it doesn’t matter one lick to those who are hell-bent on sacrificing our nation’s great history and institutions for their own political ambitions.
If it all sounds too bleak, if it feels like a foregone conclusion, here’s a reason for hope: **This chapter of history is still being written, and there are millions of Americans standing in their way. Together, this grassroots team is fighting back to defend our democracy and make sure the will of the people still matters most.**
Let’s make sure we rise to meet this moment and chart a path forward that preserves and strengthens our democracy.
[**If you’re ready, make a contribution right now and help us continue fighting for fair representation wherever and whenever it’s under attack.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115982853/572094536/1200718241?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_AGSept_email_20250926-AOTL-Tier1-AGSept-EHH_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250926-AOTL-Tier1-AGSept-EHH_&utm_campaign=AGSept&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhmZmMxMGE3LWVkOWEtZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2EsjGihf_9rW8Dg8cihq4o46U5TNc2OLRJhR_mt2pdc=)
As always, thank you for being on the right side of history.
Sincerely,

clean_body: Donate to stop the attacks on our democracy | Peter — It’s not often you can look around and realize you are living through a pivotal moment in American history. But here we are. The very foundations of our democracy — fair representation, good-faith debate, the rule of law — are being chipped away right before our eyes. And it’s all in service of politicians’ relentless pursuit of power. From Missouri to Texas, anti-democracy forces are trying to tip the scales of our democracy because they know Americans want something different than what they’re getting now. They know they’ve violated the will of the people they serve — and if it’s left up to the voters, they’ll lose their political power. But rather than change their approach to governing, rather than work on delivering real results for their constituents, they’re instead trying to manipulate the rules to help them cling to power. That’s not leading. It’s cheating. When you ask most Americans, they’ll tell you it’s wrong and shouldn’t be allowed. But it’s clear that it doesn’t matter one lick to those who are hell-bent on sacrificing our nation’s great history and institutions for their own political ambitions. If it all sounds too bleak, if it feels like a foregone conclusion, here’s a reason for hope: This chapter of history is still being written, and there are millions of Americans standing in their way. Together, this grassroots team is fighting back to defend our democracy and make sure the will of the people still matters most. Let’s make sure we rise to meet this moment and chart a path forward that preserves and strengthens our democracy. = As always, thank you for being on the right side of history. Sincerely, Eric H. # [How Washington's Spending Junkies Destroy Idaho Families](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2114823&post_id=174623944&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTc0NjIzOTQ0LCJpYXQiOjE3NTg5MDE3NTEsImV4cCI6MTc2MTQ5Mzc1MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTIxMTQ4MjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.1qmY8WVFR7e4_3w0m4YpOzCRKZyFuvOuKckqzSljdz0)
### Congress is getting high on your tax dollars
| | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Sep 26
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2114823&post_id=174623944&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTc0NjIzOTQ0LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc1ODkwMTc1MSwiZXhwIjoxNzYxNDkzNzUxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjExNDgyMyIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.OltkB1mEzjkqjdnFlL89tRRHIGBbBQm79BR2CCgIH8U&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

---

Another trillion-dollar fix in Washington D.C., and guess who's paying for their habit?
You are!
Every single day, Washington's spending addicts shoot up with more of your money. They're so hooked on debt that they can't even see the difference between fiscal responsibility and fiscal suicide. And like every addict, they'll lie, steal, and destroy everything around them to get their next hit.
Because right now, Congress is debating two spending plans to avoid a government shutdown. The media wants you to believe there's a real difference between them.
Well, there is, but... _not really._
Take a look:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae4d65c2-d270-4b0e-89d3-d64cb11cd36b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yes, it's a trillion dollars (a lot), but that's like bragging about shooting up with one needle instead of two.
You're still an addict, and you're still destroying lives.
We can't call ourselves conservatives while enabling Washington's spending addiction. There's nothing "clean" about perpetuating a system that's driven our nation $37 trillion into debt.
_**What some call a "clean extension," I call giving a loaded syringe to a junkie.**_
Here's the contradiction that should make every taxpayer see red: Republican leaders are criticizing Democrats for pushing "$1.5 trillion in wasteful spending" while simultaneously begging to give them the money to do it.
We can't condemn drug dealers while handing out free drugs.
Think about it this way:
If your neighbor was selling his kids' toys to buy meth, would you lend him money "just to keep the lights on"? That's exactly what "clean" funding does for Washington's spending addiction.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c879189-39ce-4dbc-b71c-a547e1d39623?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Every time Washington shoots up with borrowed money, your family gets financially assaulted.
* Your grocery bill at WinCo explodes...
* Your diesel costs skyrocket...
* Your property taxes get jacked up because local governments scramble to fill the gaps when federal funny money loses value...
* That pickup truck you've been saving for? Forget it!
* Your kids (or, you) buying a house in the near future? LOL.

_**Washington 's debt addiction drives up interest rates on everything you need.**_
Every hit Washington takes comes straight out of your wallet. While these spending junkies get fat government paychecks and platinum benefits, Idaho families are rationing groceries and choosing between gas money and medicine (which, is one reason why we recently voted YES on House Bill 231, to raise the Grocery Tax Credit, which helps Idaho families keep MORE of their own paychecks):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/61baa751-8645-4ea2-8957-63298e77b7dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But every year in Congress we see this debate.
And every year we hear the same shutdown scare tactics from (R)'s and (D)'s.
It's pure addict manipulation.
Because every government shutdown in history has resulted in federal employees getting full back pay and essential services keep running. What stops is the non-essential bureaucratic waste that's feeding this addiction.
_Maybe that 's exactly the intervention we need._
But somehow, we're supposed to keep enabling Washington's addiction because forcing them into rehab might be "inconvenient."
The real choice is NOT between a shutdown and normalcy.
_**It 's between intervention now and total financial overdose later.**_
When we demand "clean funding," we become drug dealers for Washington's spending addiction. We become the problem instead of the solution (and I've said as much on the Senate floor ad nauseam).
In fact, here's me predicting that we'd be at $37 trillion back in 2024:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8ed9a675-44f6-4f24-b3d4-2b5adbb3209f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Idaho deserves leaders who will stage an intervention, not enablers who hand out clean needles.
We need representatives who understand that every tax dollar comes from someone who bled for it, not from some dealer's stash house in D.C.
It's time to cut off the money supply and force these spending junkies into fiscal rehab. Our children's future depends on leaders willing to say no to addicts, even when they're screaming for their next fix.
Because at the end of the day, Idaho families are the ones getting robbed to pay for Washington's habit.
And we're done being victims.

## Kimmel returns to outrage...
In case you missed it (easy to do given his ratings), Jimmy Kimmel is back on the airwaves.
After being canned by Disney for all of a week, his show is back.
You'd think that means he apologized for his vile comments about Charlie Kirk's assassination.
Nope.
He's back without so much as a "My bad".
Of course the left is cheering his return
In the aftermath of Charlie's murder, the left was more concerned about Kimmel's employment status than investigating--or even condemning--the shooting.
They claimed that getting rid of Kimmel was an attack on free speech.
Call me crazy, but shooting a man who made his living promoting free speech feels like a little more of a violation than firing a guy who lied about it.
But the firing didn't even stick, and Kimmel's back and as uncaring as ever.

body:
It’s important that you read this message.

| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z4up17fa3vhgdfkolpku235s2c56auv6kaqfi4jg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)
---
Fellow Patriot, **[This is Zak Daniel – I want to share something deeply personal with you.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6utluf7m55kqe9488hgjvn71obejdcs9g2fdfqg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)**
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z8v050tkscksfl9euv373k78tbvak6aq3nl6em18_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)
---
_My wife Lauren is running for office as a Republican in battleground Georgia, and if you donated to her campaign recently, I can’t THANK YOU enough._ But there’s a side of Lauren she’d never brag about...As her husband, I think you deserve to hear it. **Can I get just two minutes of your time, Fellow Patriot?** It started way back in high school when Lauren and I first met. We fell in love, and at just 17, she got pregnant with our first child. We were young. We were scared. And we were surrounded by voices telling us we would have no future if we kept the baby.**_People told Lauren she was throwing her life away. That abortion was her only way out._** Long story short, we heard _every single lie_ the Democrats push on young women — that motherhood is a mistake, that life begins only when it’s convenient, and that faith should take a back seat to fear._**But Lauren stood firm. She chose LIFE. She chose OUR SON. She chose to FIGHT.**_ I’d never admired her more.Because she didn’t just survive — _she thrived_. She finished high school, graduated from Georgia State University with a Bachelor’s in English, and went on to become the **YOUNGEST FEMALE MEMBER** of the Georgia House.
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ze7n860vtiaqg84t1hskjbjuh8o397g6fk12821o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)
---
And now, she’s running against a well-funded Democrat backed by the political establishment in Atlanta. And she’s not doing it for power, but to PROTECT the values she _lives_ every single day. **I’ll be the first to tell you, the Left can’t stand Lauren.** They’re ATTACKING her for being a bold, unapologetic,** America-First mom** who puts families and faith above everything else.
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zodtlco83o774id6s2coqgkeu7ietj8sbom9tr5g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)
---
They HATE that she’s living proof that **_conservative, pro-life women are strong, capable, and ready to lead._**
---
[But make no mistake: the Democrats aren’t done attacking my wife.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zfhm7pqbkfb0gsp83ds0l21kcl3t3d2saj14up60_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)
---
The truth is, they’re trying to shut Lauren down because she’s fighting for your God-given rights – the same way she fought for the God-given right for our son to live. **If they FLIP Georgia blue, they’ll ERASE pro-life protections, DISMANTLE family-first policies, and REPLACE them with their radical, woke agenda.** They haven’t succeeded yet — but they’re getting close. That’s why Lauren needs **__[_EVERY OUNCE OF SUPPORT_](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5blp9fcv8nlqkuserslq1mumu5le6626gtc5eb0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs) __[__](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5kqbbauiui35s565lld54c0es1tpvqf13vl5pd0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)**we can give her. Because if we don’t draw the line right now, we risk losing _everything_ we’ve fought so hard to preserve. Lauren’s ready to fight. I’ve seen it in her since day one.The only question is... **[will you fight beside her?](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zi9bp5d3pmpd1n6knstmq4nfiol40drfuo6kb0so_rp22sh2s8i6epb0sji66o72cph2bs)**
---

subject: Joe Rogan and I agree
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
OK folks: Last week, ABC took Jimmy Kimmel off the air for comments he made about MAGA on his late-night show — after their parent company faced clear retaliatory regulatory threats from the FCC (aka the Trump administration).
There was massive public backlash, and rightfully so. Even Joe Rogan — the reality TV host turned podcaster, who largely sees eye to eye with Trump — said the government shouldn’t be telling comedians what to say.
I believe his exact words were, “That’s f*****g crazy.” And I agree.
This isn’t cancel culture (though if it was, it’s wild that Republicans suddenly support it??). It’s state-sanctioned censorship. The President of the United States should know and respect that our First Amendment protects all speech, not just the things he wants to hear. But of course, he doesn’t.
Even as plenty of folks in the GOP insist that this situation had nothing to do with Trump or FCC Chairman Brendan Carr’s threats, Trump himself repeatedly clarified that, actually, it has everything to do with it! When ABC reinstated Kimmel this week, Trump took to social media to whine about it — and, of course, to threaten them with a lawsuit.
And look, I’m glad Jimmy Kimmel is back on the air — but this isn’t just a one-off thing. It’s a painfully clear pattern. Just days ago, Pete Hegseth demanded that journalists sign a pledge to only report administration-approved information (even if it’s unclassified!)... or lose their Pentagon press credentials.
So, unless the news is favorable to the administration or handed directly to journalists by the government, it can’t be reported to the public?
Let’s be extremely clear: The press does not work for Donald Trump. If they did , we would no longer have a free press. We’d have state propaganda, just like anti-democratic, authoritarian regimes around the world.
Trump has attacked nearly every part of the First Amendment over the last nine months: freedom of speech, freedom of the press, freedom of religion, the right to peaceably assemble, and the right to petition the government for grievances.
These attacks destroy our democracy little by little. But we do have power here. What we’ve seen so much of from this administration isn’t just official action, but pressure campaigns and threats that way too many people — Members of Congress, business leaders, public figures — just choose to bow down to. That’s a problem.
We cannot preemptively forfeit our own First Amendment rights. We need to exercise them loudly, vigorously, and frequently.
Will you add your name right now to stand against Trump’s attacks on our fundamental American values and commit to continuing to speak out? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/JaZb5ttuqUuHJfrHTs5J_g2]
After you sign, please share this email with three friends to help build a strong coalition and keep folks engaged for the long haul!
Thanks for staying committed to this fight.
-Sara

We’ve faced unimaginable challenges in recent months, and our friends and neighbors have been by our side reminding us that our power comes from one another. Through virtual community calls, personalized resources, and youth-led events across the country, we’ve empowered you and our immigrant neighbors to join us in the fight for the future we need. The leaves will be changing soon, and we want to be prepared to bring you the tools you need to continue showing up for your community. 🍁 **✍️ Can you take our 2-minute survey today to personalize the resources and invites you receive from our team?** We take the security of your data seriously and promise to protect it at all times. **[Take the Survey](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39SJq29aAUU_MJcHLqmbGyWHnq2a9bR7UascmRGqSQYQP-1SycuZ2UJwpcCmKPsbMdOBjmKuIT3GiN0Qnc3-IeQVYO7s6zIMdI-MMnauFWHZTn13SD-UUCMx96mvgz-b_g1NrFoNFf7t1QS9d4-KFBhFyDY9YKp62wgd91bAEEkdnSgltq0swdspUiQdxA-x5EOMMUv5J8csg5lWyF7cY7vEQfeGmZvGSiPN9_tGB4QTRVmy--6dAUP5GBNc7jN1VRyIVyHYM_NOdEnA_dZv2rk/4k8/Skg1MgIeTJ-mv_U3ARF7lQ/h0/h001.i3hb9Qt65FLp6uHNhv6clhJ3r46E9hxNGEgxx24cF48)** This year alone, we’ve:

clean_body: Improve your experience by letting us know the resources you need from us! | | | Hey Peter, help us get you the resources that best suit you! 📝 As we welcome a new season, we’re looking back on every moment this year where our community has had each other’s backs. We’ve faced unimaginable challenges in recent months, and our friends and neighbors have been by our side reminding us that our power comes from one another. Through virtual community calls, personalized resources, and youth-led events across the country, we’ve empowered you and our immigrant neighbors to join us in the fight for the future we need. The leaves will be changing soon, and we want to be prepared to bring you the tools you need to continue showing up for your community. 🍁 ✍️ Can you take our 2-minute survey today to personalize the resources and invites you receive from our team? We take the security of your data seriously and promise to protect it at all times. This year alone, we’ve: Hosted important community spaces to process DACA updates together Launched the Powered by the People campaign and honored the stories of working people who fuel our communities through merch, poetry, and notes of solidarity Shared an Educator Guide with action tools for teachers and school administrators across the country to protect undocumented students As we meet this moment with resilience and courage, we want to make sure you’re the first to hear about our latest calls to action! Your time and input are extremely valuable, so we’ve kept it brief.** In community, Ximena and the rest of the United We Dream team | Follow us on: | | | | |

Imagine running for office--just weeks from Election Day--and finding out the federal government handed your Social Security number, home address, and insurance records to your political opponent. That's what just happened to Democratic gubernatorial candidate Mikie Sherrill in New Jersey.
_**[I'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/3d900186-1263-4b25-9f63-9df2f7e2fbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/3d900186-1263-4b25-9f63-9df2f7e2fbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The depths to which the Trump administration will go to attack political opponents have no bottom. Sherrill is a decorated veteran who's served this country proudly. And Trump's National Archives handed her Social Security number and private information to her Republican opponent, Jack Ciattarelli. Weeks before the election.
The race is close. Off year governor's races usually are. I worked the last one--Governor Murphy barely squeaked by. And they know this kind of sensitive info, leaked by the federal government, could tip the scales. That's how low they're willing to go. It's wrong, and it's disgusting.
The headlines will be glued to Comey's indictment or Trump sending feds to raid John Bolton's house. But it's this kind of insidious abuse that that is beneath the surface that's's most dangerous--the political operatives Trump has salted into the machinery of government. These are people who wake up angry, obsessed with grievance, totally unfit for the jobs they hold. They don't give a damn about your safety, your well-being, or the strength of the country they claim to serve. They're not protecting democracy or improve your life--they're rotting this country from the inside. And every accusation they make? It's projection.
For years they've screamed about Democrats "weaponizing" government. Meanwhile, they're the ones turning it into a tool of punishment. The sanctity of public service? Gone. The line between governance and vengeance? Gone.
_**[I'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/3d900186-1263-4b25-9f63-9df2f7e2fbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/3d900186-1263-4b25-9f63-9df2f7e2fbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now look--the federal government's never been perfect. It's slow, flawed, often fails regular people while serving the elitre. But for the most part, it tried at least try to keep the vast majority of Americans safe. There were some boundaries. But now? We've got Pete Hegseth at Defense, Kash Patel at the FBI, Pam Bondi at Justice--each one an unqualified political hitman, not a public servant. Each one actively destroying the very thing they swore to defend.
And who's running the National Archives now, by the way? Marco Rubio. Apparently he's picked up more gigs than the average American working three part-time jobs just to survive in Trump's economy.
This is dangerous. If they'll violate the privacy of a high-profile gubernatorial candidate, what do you think they'll do to you? To your information? The same stuff they're handing off to DOGE, to Elon Musk, to Trump's crooked inner circle--guys like "Big Balls" and the rest of the grifters who gutted the government, slashing critical programs, sabotaging services, even cutting cancer research for kids.
This isn't government. It's an empire of cruelty, run by people who see you as expendable. They don't care about you, me, or anyone who isn't a billionaire or part of their political circle. They're not here to help. They're here to punish.
Look at Trump's new tariffs: a 100% tax on imported pharmaceuticals. Who gets crushed by that? Not the rich. Not Trump's donors. Regular people--seniors already choosing between groceries and meds. They know it. They just don't care.
Because this is how they use power: weaponize it. Punish the opposition. Keep you afraid. Rig elections they can't win fairly.
_**[I'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/3d900186-1263-4b25-9f63-9df2f7e2fbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/3d900186-1263-4b25-9f63-9df2f7e2fbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's going to get worse before it gets better. Here's the hard truth: no one is coming to save us. It's on every single one of us to show up, speak out, and push back. Every time they pull this shit. On the streets. Online. At the dinner table when it's uncomfortable. Call out the Comey indictment. Call out the money funneled into Trump's pockets. Call out the bribes. The corruption. All of it.
The thing is--every time they overreach, the cracks show. Trump's numbers prove it. He's less popular now than he's been in a long time. Most Americans might not love Democrats, but they _hate_ what Trump and his cronies are doing--to the country, to the GOP, to the institutions we used to believe in.
And if you did vote for Trump? I'm betting this isn't what you signed up for.
But Trump and MAGA world will keep pretending they have a mandate. They'll lie about winning in a "landslide" and we cannot let them gaslight the country into thinking this is what people voted for--not even the ones who pulled the lever for him.
And while they play this game, millions of Americans don't have the luxury of "tuning out." They're living through the consequences. Right now.
Parents being detained by masked agents on their way to school drop-off.
Students at HBCUs under constant threat from white nationalist groups.
Seniors skipping meals so they can fill prescriptions.
Women turned away from hospitals during medical emergencies.
College kids terrified to graduate and the job market.
So what do we do? We speak up. We call it out. We fight through the numbness, through the fatigue, through the despair--because that's exactly what they're counting on: our silence.
Every time they weaponize power, every time they cheat, every time they try to scare us into shutting up--we push back. Not just online. In our workplaces. In our neighborhoods. In our families.
We show up for each other.
We tell the truth.
And we don't stop fighting.
Because that's the only way we make it through to the other side.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115988593/572112640/-1295403277?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20250926_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ODZiMmNiNS1mNzlhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PrXlC8oHtTYkVBm929ZrLrwxWahj0eOfdC1gKAJJbOw=&emci=080a8235-ef9a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=686b2cb5-f79a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=15529135) | Team, As you may have heard, House Republicans recently advanced a continuing resolution to keep the government funded, but **failed** to address critical issues affecting our communities. _I want to share with you why I voted NO on this resolution._ First and foremost, this proposal did _nothing_ to address my concerns about affordable health care. Our families should not have to choose between putting food on the table and visiting the doctor. **Affordable health care is a right, not a privilege, and I will continue to fight for the coverage every American deserves.** Furthermore, the resolution neglected to address the gaps in funding for nutrition assistance. In Connecticut’s Fifth District, too many families depend on these essential services. **It's unacceptable to leave them without the assurance of support as they strive to make ends meet.** Perhaps most concerning of all, the GOP indicated that they might not adhere to their own resolution. clean_body: | | Team, As you may have heard, House Republicans recently advanced a continuing resolution to keep the government funded, but failed to address critical issues affecting our communities. I want to share with you why I voted NO on this resolution. First and foremost, this proposal did nothing to address my concerns about affordable health care. Our families should not have to choose between putting food on the table and visiting the doctor. Affordable health care is a right, not a privilege, and I will continue to fight for the coverage every American deserves. Furthermore, the resolution neglected to address the gaps in funding for nutrition assistance. In Connecticut’s Fifth District, too many families depend on these essential services. It's unacceptable to leave them without the assurance of support as they strive to make ends meet. Perhaps most concerning of all, the GOP indicated that they might not adhere to their own resolution. Empty promises won't keep our government running or provide the stability our economy needs. We must demand accountability and ensure that any budgeting process puts the needs of the people first. For all these reasons, I stand with my House Democratic colleagues in fighting for a fair budget — a budget that keeps the government open and prioritizes the well-being of every citizen. Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3burvfzpg2hjcnx9esqj61tjdji7iu0xldq940850h71dzorfpshjneo9ua4ud82fttphezmbl1cxuympkaqo42gucnz9rm9ndj4yi79zx2itxcuah4bpahdlueg6xgm3mkznra8p4&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t37gm8&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t37gm8&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t37gm8&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3burvfzpg2hjcnx9esqj61tjdji7iu0xldq940850h71dzorfpshjneo9ua4ud82fttphezmbl1cxuympkaqo42gucnz9rm9ndj4yi79zx2itxcuah4bpahdlueg6xgm3mkznra8p4&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t37gm8&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t37gm8&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
| | | Peter, Yesterday, Councilmember Kendra Brooks’ resolution condemning the Trump Administration’s reckless deployment of the National Guard to American cities passed in Philadelphia's City Council. The resolution makes it clear:
* Trump has ordered troops into cities like Washington, D.C., Chicago, and Los Angeles **without the consent of local governments and without evidence of a legitimate emergency.**
* Here in Philadelphia, crime is already dropping to historic lows, thanks to investments in restorative justice and community-based safety strategies. **We do not need an occupying force.**
* The Administration’s declaration of a so-called “national emergency” and its targeting of Democratic-majority cities represents an **unprecedented threat to American democracy and civil liberties.**

Philadelphia must not (and will not) be treated like a battlefield. Real safety comes from trust, solidarity, and neighbors looking out for one another, not from troops patrolling our streets. That’s why the PA Working Families Party proudly stands with Councilmember Kendra Brooks and all those fighting to defend our community. If you share this vision, we invite you to stand with us by showing up, speaking out, and supporting this movement in whatever way you can. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Government shutdowns are bad for the country. Every one of us knows that.
But we’re a few days away from a possible shutdown because President Trump is refusing to do what has to happen: negotiate with Congressional leaders.
Trump told Republicans to write a budget they liked and “not even deal with Democrats. ” So Democrats wrote an alternative budget bill that keeps the government open while protecting everyday people from massive health care cuts.
This was not only better for our constituents — it was also consistent with what many GOP leaders are saying needs to be done.
Last weekend, Democrats in Congress asked the President to meet with leaders of both parties to negotiate a final agreement. This is the way it’s always done. And President Trump agreed.
But get this: two days later, the President cancelled the meeting, refused to meet, and threatened to fire federal employees if he didn’t get his way!
America needs a president who isn’t afraid to negotiate with Congress to keep the U.S. government open. And America needs senators and representatives who won’t accept a president shutting down the government rather than sit down at the negotiating table.
Without colleagues across the aisle who are willing to work in good faith, we just can’t make real progress — on preventing shutdowns OR on the countless other critical issues that we need to focus on, like lowering costs, protecting voting rights and reproductive freedom, and reducing gun violence.
So I’m asking you today: if you’re as fed up as I am with the kind of political game-playing that keeps getting us into this situation, please join me in supporting Democrats today with a donation of ANY amount. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]

Thank you for your support,
Tim Kaine

Fellow Conservative,

Democrats are howling at the top of their lungs that free speech is under attack.

The comparisons to Nazi Germany are back in full force, and the constant chatter about a civil war erupting is the new favorite talking point on the left.

It’s hard to escape the absolute hysteria that has overtaken the media and Americans to the left of center since Jimmy Kimmel’s show was put on indefinite hold last week.

_**But here is what I want to know: where was the outrage when Megyn Kelly was fired by NBC for making what they alleged were politically incorrect comments?**_

_**Where was the outrage when Disney abruptly let go of a prominent cast member in The Mandalorian for expressing views on social media at odds with Disney leadership?**_

_**Where was the hysteria when a lunatic leftist tried to assassinate Justice Kavanaugh?**_

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: My report from the mountain
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Like you, I’ve been doing my best to work and fight through the challenges
before us. The growing authoritarianism, the attacks on civil liberties
and the constitution... and in Texas, our fight to defend free speech and
the right to participate in our politics.

It’s the most important, most urgent thing we could be doing. But because
it’s so important and at times all-consuming, you’ve got to force yourself
to take a moment to rest and recharge every now and then.

Saturday morning I jumped in the truck with the dogs and headed into the
Black Range of the Gila Wilderness. Door-to-trailhead is just under three
hours, so by midday Artemis, Ziggy, Freya and I were walking into the
mountain and away from civilization, politics, cellphones and the
internet.

After a couple of miles I put down my backpack at a small clearing where
two canyon streams come together and the dogs and I continued up one of
the canyons. They were in heaven, bounding through the forest, chasing
squirrels, sniffing all the new smells and just running free. I felt
pretty good too, lucky to be able to do this, in awe of the giant
wilderness before us, the life all around me (including the huge pile of
bear scat we came across in one of the side canyons), the clean air I was
breathing, the way my mind was free to roam without being interrupted by a
text message, a phone call or a meeting.

I got back to where I’d left my pack, put up my tent, ate a snack, poured
myself a bit of whisky and then made a fire and boiled some water to add
to my freeze-dried pasta (yuck). I read my book until the light faded and
then just sat with the dogs under the stars, finishing dinner in front of
the fire before getting into my sleeping bag. The ground was wet from rain
earlier in the day, and when I woke up in the middle of the night I could
see the dogs shivering so I invited them into the tent and we tossed and
turned together until the sun broke.

One more little hike before heading back down the trail to the truck, and
I started to get my head around the week to come and the way I wanted to
approach the challenges ahead. The drive home was peaceful, the dogs
knocked out in the backseat.

Well, that’s my report from the mountain. I hope you are taking some time
whenever you can, to get a little distance and perspective on the work
that we’re all doing. We need each other today and for the long haul as
well.

Beto

Powered by People is putting in the work to reach, register, and mobilize
the voters we need to elect Democrats up and down the ballot in Texas.

name: Deb Haaland
subject: green chile chicken posole [recipe]
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO
body:
One thing you should know about me is that I love to cook.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=4664%2E400544%2EQ9d_IN)
Hey — it’s Deb.
One thing you should know about me is that **I love to cook.**
My love of cooking New Mexican cuisine started early, thanks to the hours I spent watching my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She wouldn’t let us kids in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours. I still hold those memories close as I prepare my favorite traditional New Mexican dishes.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250926_1_posole?amount=5&refcode=em20250926-4664&refcode2=4664_400544_Q9d_IN&akid=4664%2E400544%2EQ9d_IN)
_New Mexico chile – the best in the world!_
**There’s something powerful about connecting with others over a home-cooked meal.** When I was in law school at UNM, I’d make chicken green chile stew for student gatherings, and I made that same dish for my Congressional colleagues during the 2019 winter holiday season. I even cooked chile and tortillas for the water protectors when I traveled to Standing Rock during the protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline.
Cooking became more than a hobby after I decided to start my own salsa business. I worked out of a commercial kitchen and bought my red chile pequin from a farm in northern New Mexico. I’d prepare my salsa and deliver jars to mom-and-pop shops across the state, often with Somáh riding with me in the back seat.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250926_1_posole?amount=5&refcode=em20250926-4664&refcode2=4664_400544_Q9d_IN&akid=4664%2E400544%2EQ9d_IN)
_Here’s Somáh posing with jars of my homemade salsa. Kids in New Mexico start early... 🌶️_
**For me, cooking has always been a way to foster connection and build community, which is exactly what we’re doing now as we grow our campaign for New Mexico.** I’ve had the chance to sit down with New Mexicans in living rooms and at kitchen tables to hear about their lives, their struggles, and their hopes for the future. Every conversation is another reminder of the incredibly high stakes in this race – and proof that if we organize around our shared values, we will win.
**[Will you donate $5 before our LAST public fundraising deadline of 2025 on October 6 to help show the strength of our grassroots campaign? If you donate through this link, I’ll even send you my recipe for green chile chicken posole!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250926_1_posole?amount=5&refcode=em20250926-4664&refcode2=4664_400544_Q9d_IN&akid=4664%2E400544%2EQ9d_IN)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250926_1_posole?amount=5&refcode=em20250926-4664&refcode2=4664_400544_Q9d_IN&akid=4664%2E400544%2EQ9d_IN)**
Happy cooking,
Deb 🌶️
P.S. # **Hello Capitalists,**
### **Here is everything we are following today:**
* Trump hikes tariffs on foreign drugs to 100%
* Left-wing violence hits 30 record high, right-wing violence decreases
* Small businesses are concerned about socialism in NYC
* Amazon reaches $2.5 billion settlement for allegedly misleading Prime members

### **Today 's markets:**
* **DOW: 46180.06 (+0.77%)**
* **S &P: 6634.15 (+0.56%)**
* **NASDAQ: 22465.02 (+0.33%)**
* **CBOE VIX Volatility Index: (-6.6%)**

* * *
* * *
# Trump slaps 100% tariffs on imported drugs and more
President Donald Trump **[announced a 100% tariff on branded and patented pharmaceutical products](https://substack.com/redirect/52a0dd14-cad3-4593-8155-b46aeddef6aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** effective October 1st, unless companies are actively building manufacturing plants in the United States (defined as breaking ground or under construction).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/52a0dd14-cad3-4593-8155-b46aeddef6aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Home goods and furniture levies** : The president imposed a 50% tariff on kitchen cabinets and bathroom vanities, plus a 30% tariff on upholstered furniture, citing concerns about "flooding" of imports that threaten American manufacturers.
* **Heavy truck protection** : A 25% tariff will be placed on heavy trucks built outside the U.S. to protect domestic manufacturers like Peterbilt, Kenworth, Freightliner, and Mack Trucks, with Trump framing this as essential for national security and trucker financial health.
* **Economic concerns raised** : While Trump argues that the tariffs as protecting U.S. manufacturing and national security, some economists warn the measures could raise consumer prices.

* * *
# **[A Life of Faith, A Legacy that Endures: Remembering Charlie Kirk](https://substack.com/redirect/8a90f4fe-873d-4f5a-aec0-dd2af82c9683?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e416c7f-c783-4310-820d-bbf83470a1c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *

# Left-wing violence breaks new record, study shows
A Center for Strategic & International Studies study found that **[left-wing terrorist attacks reached record highs](https://substack.com/redirect/cbac6791-fc14-4021-aedc-ddc1ba5d8639?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the first half of 2025, with five incidents through July 4th--more than eight times the annual average from 1995-2000 and outpacing far-right attacks for the first time in 30 years.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cbac6791-fc14-4021-aedc-ddc1ba5d8639?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Anti-government motivation pattern** : The study attributed the increase to anti-government and partisan extremism opposing the Trump administration, noting that "all left-wing attacks through July 4, 2025, appeared to be motivated by one of these ideologies," including Charlie Kirk's assassination by Tyler Robinson who inscribed "hey fascist, catch this" on shell casings.
* **Democratic rhetoric under scrutiny** : The analysis comes amid criticism of Democratic leaders' language, with officials like Tim Walz calling ICE a "modern-day Gestapo," Gavin Newsom describing it as a "private domestic army," and Kamala Harris agreeing Trump was a "fascist"--rhetoric the White House has urged Democrats to tone down.
* **Immigration enforcement flashpoint** : The study highlighted immigration as a major trigger for violence, exemplified by the Dallas ICE facility attack, while noting that right-wing terrorism declined this year, possibly because "some extremists do not feel the need to act violently if their concerns are being addressed" under Trump's presidency.

* * *
* * *
# Small businesses fear possible socialist leadership in NYC
Small Business Administrator Kelly Loeffler warned that NYC's 100,000+ small businesses employing nearly 1 million people **[are fearful that democratic socialist candidate Zohran Mamdani's policies](https://substack.com/redirect/d612a04b-2b28-4b1e-9f9e-b30b873b53d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** could accelerate population loss and drive jobs to red states.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d612a04b-2b28-4b1e-9f9e-b30b873b53d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Specific policy worries** : Loeffler highlighted concerns about Mamdani's proposals including potential $30/hour minimum wage, government takeover of industries, rising regulation and taxes, plus his campaign promises of free buses, city-owned grocery stores, and rent freezes that have rattled Wall Street.
* **Red state migration trend** : Loeffler cited ongoing economic migration patterns where "the fastest growing states in this country are red states" like Texas, Florida, and Georgia due to pro-business policies, while blue states including New York have lost population and businesses over the past four years.
* **Federal bailout rejection** : Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent reinforced warnings that if Mamdani's economic policies drive NYC into financial crisis and the city seeks a federal bailout, the Trump administration would refuse, referencing Gerald Ford's famous "drop dead" response to New York's 1970s financial troubles.

* * *
* * *
# Amazon reached multi-billion dollar settlement after allegedly lying to Prime members
Amazon agreed to pay $2.5 billion to settle FTC allegations, including a $1 billion civil penalty (the largest in FTC history) and a $1.5 billion consumer reimbursement fund for **[allegedly tricking customers into Prime subscriptions](https://substack.com/redirect/647a3c29-23fb-4712-9b3f-ff08447c7dcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and making cancellation extremely difficult.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/647a3c29-23fb-4712-9b3f-ff08447c7dcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Consumer compensation eligibility** : Customers who used three or fewer Prime benefits during any 12-month period from June 2019 to June 2025 are automatically eligible for $51 payments, while those who used Prime benefits fewer than 10 times can receive the same amount through a claims process.
* **Required interface changes** : Amazon must implement simple cancellation processes that are as easy as signing up, clearly inform customers about trial terms and costs, and provide transparent steps for cancellation--changes the FTC says will prevent future "subscription traps" that affected nearly 40 million consumers.
* **Broader regulatory context** : The settlement comes as Amazon faces a separate major antitrust lawsuit involving Prime set for trial in February 2027, while a federal appeals court struck down the FTC's broader rule requiring easy subscription cancellations across all companies, forcing case-by-case enforcement instead.

Throughout his time in the State House, including as Michigan's Speaker of the House, he's fought hard for Michiganders and achieved real results for the people of our state. This endorsement is a big deal, Peter. Joe knows this Senate race is pivotal, and I know he'll fight hard alongside us to ensure we defeat Trump’s handpicked MAGA candidate, Mike Rogers, and take back the Senate for Democrats. But with election experts calling our battleground race a "Toss-Up" and a GOP super PAC already hauling in $5 million to defeat me, I need a surge of grassroots support at this key moment to compete and win. body:
Patriot,
Last night both my opponent, Congressman Tony Gonzales, and I were invited to a Young Republicans candidate forum.
Guess who didn't show?
My opponent has proven time and again that he's a coward. He refuses to debate, refuses to take voters' questions, refuses to show up. That's fine with me, because he can run, but he can't hide -- not from his record, and not from the voters on Election Day.
Let me tell you about his record:
❌ He voted to specifically target our veterans with a red flag law, depriving them of both their 2nd Amendment rights and their right to due process.
❌ He cooperated with Democrats to pass draconian new gun control regulations under President Biden.
❌ He voted to take away your 4th Amendment rights and permit warrantless surveillance of American citizens.
❌ He supported the creation of a National Vaccine Tracking Database.
❌ He voted with every Democrat to create the January 6th Commission to investigate, prosecute, and imprison President Trump.
And that's just a small sample of his far-left votes. There are many more -- and many more to come if we allow him to stay in office.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3523689d-0922-4a4a-abcd-6af692c03441?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

For those of you who missed it,
[Pledge your support](https://substack..EIiK1FBEKJcBU19ACbpsmYoQDj0qzgvSK42UIOuty0Y?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=174636788)
**On Tuesday, one of the holiest days of the Jewish calendar --Rosh Hashanah--the United Nations General Assembly convened, while the Security Council scheduled a high-stakes meeting on the Gaza war that afternoon. Absent from that meeting due to the Jewish Holidays was Israel. The timing drew criticism from Israel and Jewish leaders worldwide, including Israel's Ambassador to the UN, Danny Danon, who noted that scheduling such an important meeting effectively excluded observant Jews and Israeli representatives from participation while Palestinian Ambassador Riyad Mansour addressed the Council.**
**This is not the first time the UN has done this. Despite a 2015 UN resolution officially recognizing Yom Kippur as a UN holiday (meant to prevent meetings on that day), the UN has repeatedly scheduled sessions and debates on Jewish holy days. By contrast, major Christian and Muslim holidays are generally respected, and no official business is scheduled. This is a long-standing pattern of disregard for Jewish observances, and reinforces the view that the UN 's institutional bias against Israel is deliberate. Yesterday's Security Council debate on Gaza underscored that bias with the ongoing conflict.**
**Trump Projects U.S. Strength and Resilience at the UNGA**
**Despite this backdrop, Israel 's strongest ally, the United States, stood firmly behind Israel through [President Trump's General Assembly address](https://substack.com/redirect/40b1a93e-03ab-428c-86c3-ec7318d88e3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He projected American strength and called for:**
* **Peace through strength;**
* **Secure borders; and**
* **Protection of Christians from religious persecution.**

**Trump contrasted his current leadership with the prior Biden administration, stating:**
**" Since that day, the guns of war have shattered the peace I forged on two continents. An era of calm and stability gave way to one of the great crises of our time."**
**President Trump described how the Biden Administration weakened U.S. credibility worldwide, and contrasted that with his renewed leadership which has enabled America to enter a "golden age" of economic vitality, energy independence, and strong borders. Trump pledged that America "stands ready" to provide nations with abundant energy, warned hostile regimes that U.S. power would be used when necessary, and reminded the UN General Assembly that his Administration is responsible for ending seven wars once deemed "unendable."**
**Trump Rebuke 's the UN**
**Trump took the time on stage to blast the UN for its history of issuing empty resolutions and strongly written letters without enforcement, saying:**
**" It's empty words and empty words don't solve war. The only thing that solves wars is action."**
**President Trump cited his achievements in ending wars and brokering the Abraham Accords, while noting he received no credit for his peace efforts:**
**" Everyone says I should get the Nobel Peace Prize... But for me, the real prize will be the sons and daughters who live to grow up with their mothers and fathers," said Trump, explaining how he puts lives over prestige.**
**Trump Turns to Iran, Israel, and Ukraine**
**A major focus of the speech was Iran, Israel, and Ukraine --issues where he said the UN could play a positive role if it chose to act decisively once and for all, and if the UN members acted in concert as its current method is divisive, rewards bad behavior, and fuels conflicts, especially in Ukraine by buying Russian energy.**
**Iran**
**Trump highlighted Operation Midnight Hammer, in which seven US B-2 bombers dropped 14 massive bombs on Iran 's nuclear facilities. President Trump declared:**
**" No other country on earth could have done what we did... We have the greatest weapons on earth. We hate to use them, but we did something that for 22 years people wanted to do."**
**This show of force allowed Trump to broker an end to the 12-day war between Israel and Iran, with both sides agreeing to halt hostilities.**
**Israel**
**Turning to Gaza, Trump demanded a ceasefire conditioned on Hamas 's rejection of terrorism. He described the devastation of October 7th, and warned that granting statehood under current conditions rewards terrorism:**
**" Those who want peace should be united with one message: release the hostages now. Just release the hostages now."**
**Trump referenced 20 living hostages and 38 murdered captives, underscoring the pleas made to him and Senator Marco Rubio by grieving parents.**
**His remarks carried even more weight given that Israel 's representatives were absent from the Security Council discussions that afternoon due to Rosh Hashanah, while the Palestinians had an open floor without Israel present to provide their own account of the horrors of Hamas.**
**Ukraine**
**Trump criticized NATO and Europe for funding Russia 's war through continued energy purchases, despite sanctions:**
**" You're buying oil and gas from Russia while you're fighting Russia. Who the hell ever heard of that?"**
**He suggested that if diplomacy failed, US-led tariffs, coupled with equal tariffs by European allies much closer to the conflict, could end the war swiftly by stopping Russia 's funding source.**
**Closing Remarks**
**Though sharply critical of the UN 's failures (including a poorly renovated building with inferior finishes and cost overruns, along with a perhaps intentionally broken escalator and teleprompter), Trump ended on a conciliatory note to the UNGA, calling for a collective effort to build a better world:**
**" Let us all work together to build a bright, beautiful planet... richer, better, and more beautiful than ever before."**
_**Stay tune for Part 2, which will cover Trump 's remarks on biological weapons, UN-sponsored migration, the southern border, climate policy, and other issues.**_

Wounded Knee was a massacre, and the men who participated in it were murderers. Full stop.
#
Peter,
Wounded Knee was a massacre of hundreds of women, children, and elders of the Lakota Nation, and the men who participated in it were murderers. Full stop.
In 1990, both houses of Congress formally expressed the United States’ regret for the massacre. Before he left office, former Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin began the process of stripping 19 Medals of Honor from the war criminals who led the massacre at Wounded Knee, but Pete Hegseth just put an end to it. To Pete Hegseth and Donald Trump, those who engaged in the killings are worthy of our highest honors — just like Confederates who betrayed their oaths and their country, but still have their surnames on our bases, with a wink and a nod.
Honoring people like that tells this generation of Troops that crimes against humanity do not matter and illegal orders don’t matter. That's the kind of Military Trump wants, and that Pete Hegseth is trying to create.
It’s why he’s purged senior officers he finds insufficiently loyal, and why he’s pushing loyalty pledges at the Pentagon. It’s why he has gutted the Judge Advocate General corps of Military lawyers, responsible for enforcing rules and regulations. And it’s why he has banned the free press at the Pentagon, restricting them only to report “authorized” stories.
Decency, honor, the Constitution — these things might not matter to Hegseth or Trump, but they do to real Americans.
It will take decades to fix what Trump and Hegseth are breaking. There are tough times ahead. But each of us has a responsibility to do whatever we can to limit the damage they are doing.

These last several months have been tough. I’ve heard so many stories from folks back home in the district – worried about their health care, rising costs, and the future of our country.

In Congress, I’ve made it a point to demand accountability from this administration and my colleagues on the other side of the aisle. We must keep working against the MAGA agenda.

As you can imagine, national Republicans aren’t so happy with people like me who are taking a stand. It’s why the NRCC is already airing baseless attack ads against me, and why I have a challenger with the full might of the GOP machine behind him.

While the midterm elections are over a year away, we’re making preparations now for the battle to come. I was one of only a handful of Democrats who flipped GOP-held seats in November, and that makes me one of the most at-risk incumbents in Congress.
