body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter,
In case you missed it - earlier this week President Trump, RFK Jr., and other members of this administration hosted another reckless press conference, this time about acetaminophen. They used their platform to further scare and confuse women with claims that are not backed up by science.
Peter, first and foremost: please consult your doctor before making any healthcare decisions.
As many of you know, I spent my career as an OB-GYN and had the honor and privilege of caring for Minnesotans for more than twenty years. While I watched this press conference, I could not stop thinking about my patients. I spent decades having conversations with them, talking through their concerns and anxieties and helping them make informed decisions about what was best for them and their pregnancy. Hearing Donald Trump and RFK Jr. distort complex studies and basic research standards and contradict standard of care medical advice was incredibly concerning.
I first ran for office after the 2016 election in part because I wanted to be a voice for science and evidence-based policy making. I’ve worked to do just that ever since. I joined my colleagues in the Democratic Doctors Caucus and called for RFK Jr’s resignation BEFORE this week's fear-mongering press conference. The medical misinformation - on top of the unprecedented cuts to healthcare and medical research made by this administration - are a dangerous and cruel pile on.
I will continue to fight for science and medical research. As a physician, I know what is at stake: the health and well-being of the American people.
Thank you for your partnership in this work.
With gratitude and resolve,
Kelly Morrison

| Peter, it’s Carol.

My least favorite part of running for Congress is asking for money.

I didn’t get into this race to fundraise. I got into it to fight for working families, to protect our freedoms, and to make sure Pennsylvania has a representative who puts people over politics. Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc._

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. name: Barack Obama
subject: Peter, if we all step up, we can defend our democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
We are being tested. How much do we care about the democratic ideals and principles that generations in this country have fought for?

---
Peter, I was born in 1961. And over the course of my lifetime, our democracy got better. It became more fair, and more transparent. More people had a seat at the table, and we were able to start addressing more long-standing injustices. Because people were paying attention to the poor and the voiceless, we started passing legislation to make sure that our daughters had the same opportunities as our sons, and that people with different sexual orientations could live their lives freely. The lives of ordinary Americans improved in very concrete ways. I think we started believing that, with each successive decade, things would just keep getting better. They certainly weren’t going backwards. But that’s never been the case – not just in American history, but in human history. Progress does not move in a straight line. Every step of the way, people who were afraid of having true democracy — who felt threatened by the efforts to ensure everybody has a voice and who realized the existing systems that privileged them might go away — have tried to constrain and even roll back our gains. We’re seeing it happen again right now. **This White House and Republican-controlled state governments do not appear to believe in the idea of an inclusive, expansive democracy.** They do not see a problem with a minority of Americans controlling the majority of legislatures, along with the White House and the courts. They’re willing to gerrymander districts for partisan gain and splinter communities to dilute their representation. And they’re not shy about saying so. This is not a bug to them, it’s a feature of the kind of so-called “democracy” they’d like to see in America. **Eric Holder and I launched the National Democratic Redistricting Committee to take on these anti-democratic forces — and to mobilize a response capable of stopping anyone who wants to take us backward. Peter,

Friend, this could be the last email we send you... for the month. **Our End of Quarter Fundraising Deadline is coming up on the 30th and we need your help to reach our goal of raising $80,000 online before then.** We know how annoying it can be to have campaigns emailing and texting you everyday before the end of the month asking you to help them reach their goal, so we're going to try something different. If you donate any amount between now and the 30th then you won't hear from us for the rest of the month. **This could actually be our last email to you for September.** And if you make a recurring donation of any amount then we won't send you anything until our next FEC deadline in December. Friend, it's Kat Abughazaleh, and if this isn't a sign of what's to come, I don't know what is.
As always, if you'd like to receive fewer emails, click [**here**](https://ka4il.us/l/3HyvjLd0ZU97)**,** or if you'd like to unsubscribe from all future emails, click **here**.
**_Donald Trump is planning on attacking payment processor ActBlue in another attempt by his administration to push the limits of his power._**
The detainment of Mahmoud Kahlil, the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, and the outright denial to follow a ruling made by the Supreme Court are all blatant oversteps that attack our right to free speech and due process and challenge the rule of law.
Friend, I've spent years watching Fox News and listening to their rhetoric get more and more extreme, and Donald Trump is doing exactly what they want.
**_Fascism is, and has always been, their end goal._**
Their vision is one of a militarized country where only certain people—a few dozen rich men—have a seat at the table, and dissidents like me are silenced.
Trump and Elon know that progressive movements like ours are in the way because I've made it abundantly clear that strongly worded letters, wearing matching outfits while holding up signs, and meaningless acts of symbolism **aren't my thing.**
As a member of Congress, I'm going to be unwavering in my fight for our communities.
I will not vote for authoritarian bills in the name of "compromise," I will not abandon or demonize vulnerable groups to cater to the right, and I will not change my stances for fear of retaliation.
And Friend, that's what this action on ActBlue is: retaliation. Campaigns like ours rely on small dollars from people like you to support us, and ActBlue is integral to making that work.

body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

We’re staring down the barrel of yet another government shutdown. This
time, Trump and the House GOP refuse to even sit down with Democrats to
negotiate – but expect their votes to keep the government open when the
time comes.

When faced with a similar situation in March, Senate Minority Leader Chuck
Schumer caved. This time, the question on everyone’s mind is whether the
Democrats will hold strong, use this moment to stand up to Trump and his
backers, and show the country that this is NOT a moment for business as
usual.

We want to hear from Our Revolution supporters to understand what our
movement believes that the Democrats should prioritize at this crucial
moment in history. Can you take a quick minute to fill out this survey and
tell us where you stand? Here’s the first question:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34219?source=email-20250926&t=1011&akid=9433%2E5885482%2EGkcuSm ]Should Democrats hold strong and refuse to vote to fund the government
next week?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34219?source=email-20250926&t=1012&akid=9433%2E5885482%2EGkcuSm ]Yes

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34219?source=email-20250926&t=1013&akid=9433%2E5885482%2EGkcuSm ]No

One thing is clear: while Republicans run roughshod over norms and the
law, we cannot keep allowing our Democratic leaders to continue chasing
“compromise.” But a key question is what concessions our movement believes
Democrats should demand in return for their vote.

Democratic leadership has zeroed in on health care: demanding a reversal
of the unprecedented cuts to Medicaid from earlier this year and an
extension of the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare) subsidies that help
millions of Americans afford health insurance from their state
marketplaces.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34219?source=email-20250926&t=1014&akid=9433%2E5885482%2EGkcuSm ]Headline: Jeffries demands 'ironclad' health care deal in latest shutdown

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/26/2025
body:
Colorado GOP to vote on opt-out in a high-stakes decision tomorrow
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Lots to cover today. We _encourage you not to skip a beat._ Thanks for being here, enjoy!
🗳️ Tomorrow, the Colorado GOP State Central Committee votes on whether to **opt out of Proposition 108’s state-run primary system**. [Todd Watkins](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) argues that opting out would return nominations to assemblies or conventions, while [Rep. Ken DeGraaf](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) cites election security, fiscal waste, and the risk of unaffiliated voters. Both see the decision as pivotal for Republican unity and constitutional rights. Read both pieces before tomorrow’s vote to understand what’s at stake.
_**Against Opt-Out:** [What does it mean to opt out?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ _**For Opt-Out:** [Rep. Ken DeGraaf’s top 10 reasons for opting out](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_
**📌 ICYMI: The Final Chapter of the Durango Dirty Dozen** Day 12 of our Durango 9-R Dirty Dozen series is here. Parents spoke up—and the district attacked. In our closing exposé, Heidi calls out 9-R leadership for dismissing concerns, dodging accountability, and undermining families. This marks the end of the series, but not the fight. We’ll soon launch a dedicated site with all 12 videos so you can revisit, share, and spread the word. Watch the final message now, and get ready to demand better for Durango kids. Catch up on [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [TikTok](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
📆 Lastly, a note about an exciting event coming up next week! Join the Arapahoe County GOP for the 2025 “Tip of the Spear” Lincoln Day Dinner on Thursday, October 2nd, from 6–10 PM. This year’s keynote speaker is award-winning investigative journalist Lara Logan. Guests will also meet local GOP candidates running in key races this November while enjoying dinner, conversation, and community. [Tickets are available here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Instead of a summary of today's news, we encourage you to head to [rockymountainvoice.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and take a look around! You can find our top stories of the day below. We hope you have a wonderful weekend! Stay sharp, stay bold, and stay in the fight.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, September 26, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Spending Is The Real Underlying Problem](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RUSS MINARY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_“Too many people spend money they haven’t earned, to buy things they don’t want, to impress people they don’t like.” – Will Rogers_
_Will Rogers (1879–1935) was an American humorist, entertainer and cowboy philosopher. He had no college degree, but he was smarter (and funnier) than most of the experts, economists and bureaucrats of his day, many of whom went broke in the Depression. Will had common sense which is uncommon today._
_This article will put a different and positive perspective on a problem that will eventually bankrupt all of us: SPENDING. Our nation is being slowly consumed by massive unsustainable DEBT. Debt doesn’t happen without spending. Spending is a problem with businesses, government – and many average Americans._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[D49 Moves to Protect Privacy With Biological Sex Bathroom Policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* District 49 (Colorado Springs) voted to protect student privacy and safety by designating bathrooms and locker rooms according to biological sex, while also offering single-stall options for those seeking additional privacy.
* Supporters emphasize that the policy ensures compliance with Title IX, upholding fairness and protecting the rights of all students in education.
* While critics objected, board members defended the move as common-sense leadership that prioritizes the well-being of the overwhelming majority of families in the district.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[State budget director warns Colorado could face 50–50 chance of recession in 2026](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado’s budget director warned the state faces a 50–50 chance of recession in 2026, citing uncertainty from tariffs, immigration policy, and federal spending.
* Economists report signs of weakening: slowed job growth, reduced business investment, sluggish consumer spending, rising debt, softening housing, and declining tourism, with Colorado dropping from 10th to 40th in state economy rankings.
* Medicaid costs are driving a massive budget shortfall, projected to eat up $644 million more next year—a growth rate twice that of the general fund—leaving the 2026 budget $850 million in the red.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Growth Mindset Betrayed: How Schools Preach Effort but Reward Excuses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY PRISCILLA RAHN | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 24** _Policies like minimum F grades, lowered expectations, and racial affinity groups are undermining resilience, accountability, and true learning—while students watch the very lessons of growth mindset go unpracticed._

**[From pulpits to school boards and special districts: A call for Christians to step up](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY CHUCK O'REILLY | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 24** _Every decision about schools, taxes and local government touches the lives of families in the pews each week. When Christians disengage from civic life, we leave those decisions to others—and the results are visible in our classrooms, neighborhoods and property tax bills._
______
**[Has AI Begun Transforming Employment in the Colorado Legal Services Industry?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY MIKE O'DONNELL | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 23** _The two biggest ongoing threats to democracy in Colorado are the less-than-competent Secretary of State, Jena Griswold, and Colorado’s Supreme Court. You will recall that last year both blocked the inclusion of Donald Trump’s name on the November 2024 presidential ballot in Colorado only to have the nation’s Supreme Court definitively overrule both._ **[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Hoosiers Deserve Better After 21+ Years of One-Party Republican Rule The Republican supermajority at the Statehouse and Governor Mike Braun’s administration has left Indiana wholly unprepared for the oncoming cuts to healthcare and SNAP services for Hoosiers. The costs to the state are expected to double for Medicaid services in the coming years, and further cuts to federal programs hurt Hoosier families with disabled children and seniors who rely on Medicaid services. Democrats know we shouldn’t be making families fearful of losing the care they need. It’s time for the constant corruption to end and for Hoosier families to be put first. Trump Administration Bails Out Argentinian Farmers, Leaves American Farmers Out to Dry This week, the Trump Administration announced a $20 billion investment in the economy of Argentina. This administration is literally ready to help the economy of South America before investing in the United States. The infusion is seen to widely benefit Argentine farmers, especially those who grow soybeans. This is despite the fact that American farmers are struggling to find new markets for their soybean products after the President’s costly trade wars and tariff taxes. Our farmers deserve to be put first. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week, we are once again highlighting the work of Congressman Frank Mrvan. He’s standing up for Northwest Indiana workers after the Trump administration repealed funding for a critical Citgo terminal in East Chicago. This cut threatens hundreds of good-paying, union jobs in the Region. Frank is always fighting to bring more dollars home to where they belong, right here in Indiana. That’s why he knows it’s critically important to support projects that put Hoosiers to work. Fellow Conservative,

They’re calling us **_“backward,” “extreme,”_** and worse — labels meant to dismiss and divide. Rep. Jasmine Crockett’s harsh words about President Trump aren’t just about him. They’re aimed at you, me, and anyone who cherishes America’s values, respects our nation’s heritage, or believes in standing firm for what’s right.

They think we’re obstacles to their agenda. They believe we’ll stay silent. But I know better — and so do you.

I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I’ve served in over 70 countries, led teams through high-stakes missions, and faced challenges that tested my resolve. Through it all, I learned that disciplined action and quiet strength always prevail.

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — to fight for our state with focus, humility, and unwavering commitment.

I never imagined a career in politics. But returning home from deployments, I saw a Minnesota drifting from the values that shaped me. My opponent, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, and a radical transgender activist, pushes a far-left vision that’s out of touch with our communities. _**While chaos gripped our streets in 2020, she criticized those working to restore order, leaving businesses and families to bear the cost.**_****

Friend,
**I’m worried.**
I’m facing one of the most critical End-of-Quarter deadlines of the year and we're still thousands short of our goal.
We have already seen how far the Democrats and their radical allies are willing to go to silence our fight to put America First.
**But NOW, it’s escalated like never before.**
The radical Left has not only painted a big red target on my back, but YOURS.
And thanks to their constant wave of attacks, and even threats, they’ve successfully depleted a large portion of my campaign’s defense funds needed to continue fighting back. **__** **_Their attacks will NEVER stop._****__[And I need your help before it’s too late](https://link.email.greene4congress.)_._**
[](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
[RUSH IN AN EMERGENCY DONATION](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
Your support will give my campaign the resources to hire staff and security, make videos, fend off their attacks and continue standing up in Congress to take our country back.
**_But right now, I’m worried my campaign won’t reach our End-of-Quarter goal._**
I know times are tough. So I’m only asking if you can absolutely afford to chip in at this time.
**_[If $15 or more is too much, even a gift of $10 or just $5 goes a long way](https://link.email.greene4congress.)_****.**
I’m so thankful to Patriots like you for having my back.
None of this would be possible without you.
I’ll be in touch.
_Your fellow patriot_

**Marjorie Taylor Greene**

This is what solidarity looks like.

---
Hey — it's Lily Tomlin. You know, most friendships don't involve civil disobedience. But then again, most friendships aren't like mine and Jane's. We've marched together at the Women's March. We've stood on picket lines supporting striking writers and actors. We've protested pipelines threatening Indigenous communities. **And yes, we've been zip-tied and hauled away by police in front of the U.S. Capitol for demanding climate action.** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116001217/572152690/1114036190?refcode=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ms=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRhNjI2MDU2LTBkOWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3U602SnzJMpz754vFUvxiWh3vFYQk3lL1gEqQEkAtAc=) _Photo by Ted Eytan._ **I’d do it again 100 times over, because the climate crisis is the fight of our lifetimes, and I refuse to sit on the sidelines while greedy corporations drive our planet to the brink of disaster.** **[Don’t worry... you don’t need to join us in jail to make an impact. Instead, chip in what you can to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC before their end-of-quarter deadline to join Jane and me in the fight to elect the next generation of climate leaders.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116001218/572152691/1114036190?refcode=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ms=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRhNjI2MDU2LTBkOWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3U602SnzJMpz754vFUvxiWh3vFYQk3lL1gEqQEkAtAc=)** Being willing to put your body on the line for what you believe in changes you. It reminds you that some fights are worth any risk, and that real change requires people who won't back down. That’s why I couldn’t be prouder of my friend Jane. What she has built with the Jane Fonda Climate PAC is one of the most inspiring examples I've seen of what true dedication to our planet looks like. They’re working around the clock to elect climate champions at every level of government, from city councils to Congress, who are brave enough to put people over profit and take the fossil fuel industry head-on. Scientists warn we have just a few years left to significantly reduce planet-warming carbon emissions to avoid the worst impacts of the climate crisis. **Every fraction of a degree the planet warms means deadlier heat waves, more catastrophic wildfires, and a heartbreaking loss of biodiversity. It’s why we need to act — _right now._** **[Jane tells me that her team is facing a big fundraising deadline on September 30th, and she needs your help. Will you join me in supporting Jane and the incredible work she’s doing by chipping in before their end-of-quarter deadline?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116001219/572152692/1114036190?refcode=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ms=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRhNjI2MDU2LTBkOWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3U602SnzJMpz754vFUvxiWh3vFYQk3lL1gEqQEkAtAc=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116001220/572152693/1114036190?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ms=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRhNjI2MDU2LTBkOWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3U602SnzJMpz754vFUvxiWh3vFYQk3lL1gEqQEkAtAc=) | [**DONATE $25**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116001221/572152694/1114036190?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ms=ea.da626056-0d9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRhNjI2MDU2LTBkOWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3U602SnzJMpz754vFUvxiWh3vFYQk3lL1gEqQEkAtAc=)

clean_body: This is what solidarity looks like. | Hey — it's Lily Tomlin. You know, most friendships don't involve civil disobedience. But then again, most friendships aren't like mine and Jane's. We've marched together at the Women's March. We've stood on picket lines supporting striking writers and actors. We've protested pipelines threatening Indigenous communities. And yes, we've been zip-tied and hauled away by police in front of the U.S. Capitol for demanding climate action. = Photo by Ted Eytan. I’d do it again 100 times over, because the climate crisis is the fight of our lifetimes, and I refuse to sit on the sidelines while greedy corporations drive our planet to the brink of disaster. = Being willing to put your body on the line for what you believe in changes you. It reminds you that some fights are worth any risk, and that real change requires people who won't back down. That’s why I couldn’t be prouder of my friend Jane. What she has built with the Jane Fonda Climate PAC is one of the most inspiring examples I've seen of what true dedication to our planet looks like. They’re working around the clock to elect climate champions at every level of government, from city councils to Congress, who are brave enough to put people over profit and take the fossil fuel industry head-on. Scientists warn we have just a few years left to significantly reduce planet-warming carbon emissions to avoid the worst impacts of the climate crisis. Every fraction of a degree the planet warms means deadlier heat waves, more catastrophic wildfires, and a heartbreaking loss of biodiversity. It’s why we need to act — right now. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = This is the fight of our lives, and we cannot afford to lose. Team --
Remember when Donald Trump promised to release the Epstein files?
_Did anyone really think the sexual predator president who used to party with Jeffrey Epstein was going to release the Epstein files?_
Instead, he’s been busy taking away your health care to cut taxes for the rich and threatening to strip Americans of their citizenship and send them to foreign prisons.
We were told Donald Trump’s new GOP cared about working people.
But you can’t claim to be for working men and women when you defund their hospitals and nursing homes.
You can’t claim to be for working men and women when you defund school lunch programs that help feed little boys and girls whose hard-working parents are struggling to fill the fridge.
Let me tell you what it’s been like in Washington these last eight months.
The leaders of Georgia’s clinics and hospitals and nursing homes, caregivers for seniors and the disabled, nurses, teachers, food pantry directors — they all came to us and pleaded with Georgia's representatives in Congress: don’t do this. Don’t devastate health care. Don’t abandon seniors. Don’t starve kids.
Sen. Warnock and I listened. We fought that bill, and we voted No.
We put Georgia first.
But every Republican member of Congress who is supposed to represent Georgia put loyalty to Trump over loyalty to our state.
***
That brings me to the 2026 election.
_2026 is our only hope to recover Congressional power and reverse this descent toward one-man rule._
And here in Georgia I am the only Democratic U.S. Senator nationwide up for reelection in a state Trump won.
I am therefore MAGA’s #1 target for defeat.
_There is no path back without defending this seat — the seat that secured the Democratic majority four years ago._

* **Fighting back against rigged maps.** Republicans are shamelessly gerrymandering districts to cling to power and silence voters. We need to fight back and stop them from tilting the playing field even more than they already have.

We know what it takes to go toe-to-toe with the Republican dark-money machine. Meeting this fundraising goal is about whether we have the resources to fight back against voter suppression, corruption, and a system rigged for the wealthy.

Peter,

Barbie has had over 200 jobs. Some days, I feel like I'm not far behind her.

I started working when I was just nine years old, mowing lawns in my neighborhood. By 14, I had my first official job waiting tables at Koke's Drugstore Diner in my hometown. I'll never forget that very first day, when I walked away with $17 in tips. To me, that felt like a fortune. **When my dad picked me up, I showed him what I'd earned, and he couldn't have been prouder._He told me I was learning one of the most important lessons in life: the value of hard work._**

That lesson stuck with me. Over the years, I worked wherever I could: in a hospital billing department trying to make sense of doctors' handwriting (still the hardest job I've ever had!), cleaning homes, picking fruit with my family, and even spending a summer working at a clothing store. Every job taught me something new.

And when it came time for college, there was no free ride—I worked my way through. After, I became an engineering intern for the Florida Department of Environmental Protection, inspecting wastewater plants and making sure drinking water was safe in everything from restaurants to office buildings. It wasn't glamorous, but it mattered. After law school, I became a lawyer, a law professor, and eventually a state representative.

**At every stage, work has been my constant. I know the struggles working people face, because I've lived them.** I know what it means to stretch every paycheck, to work multiple jobs, and push through exhaustion because you don't have a choice. I'm running for Congress to bring the voices of working people into a place where, too often, we are overlooked.

That's why this first end-of-quarter deadline matters. When our fundraising numbers go public, everyone will see whether we have the strength to take on Mariannette Miller-Meeks and the GOP. We've set a $30,000 end-of-quarter goal, and hitting it will show the power of a campaign fueled by working Iowans. **[I've worked hard all my life to get ahead. I know you have, too. clean_body: Barbie has had over 200 jobs. Some days, I feel like I'm not far behind her. | = Peter, Barbie has had over 200 jobs. Some days, I feel like I'm not far behind her. I started working when I was just nine years old, mowing lawns in my neighborhood. By 14, I had my first official job waiting tables at Koke's Drugstore Diner in my hometown. I'll never forget that very first day, when I walked away with $17 in tips. To me, that felt like a fortune. When my dad picked me up, I showed him what I'd earned, and he couldn't have been prouder.He told me I was learning one of the most important lessons in life: the value of hard work. That lesson stuck with me. Over the years, I worked wherever I could: in a hospital billing department trying to make sense of doctors' handwriting (still the hardest job I've ever had!), cleaning homes, picking fruit with my family, and even spending a summer working at a clothing store. Every job taught me something new. And when it came time for college, there was no free ride—I worked my way through. After, I became an engineering intern for the Florida Department of Environmental Protection, inspecting wastewater plants and making sure drinking water was safe in everything from restaurants to office buildings. It wasn't glamorous, but it mattered. After law school, I became a lawyer, a law professor, and eventually a state representative. At every stage, work has been my constant. I know the struggles working people face, because I've lived them. I know what it means to stretch every paycheck, to work multiple jobs, and push through exhaustion because you don't have a choice. I'm running for Congress to bring the voices of working people into a place where, too often, we are overlooked. That's why this first end-of-quarter deadline matters. ## Miraculous Recovery for School Shooting Victim
Twelve-year-old Sophia Forchas is making [a “miraculous” recovery](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAURL_G7ogAG5NbUGyTLttuiQhc7LvCYAFJlL9feaWn9wGvHI00M2f-3O3dUaK8_nY7mrhG22OxGd8tYe9Y7U7V-Wcqz1bRlxfWD-WOtR1WcqkYByYXGxylj1VjMBFR4jSiEVpdQWgAPW5mCgiP6EHzANGrWTuQs56jg-uMYXmMZM40DnKRXIBaLtxp95hATUIpqaMaZo6BeqmXv4Vy3zCmz7nm4ss-JrP1frRh-jXI2yBvB5Yj4WkN8rZTzuiOkqix5rdSEmtbKZ3yyl7kO-2n7mxDF9g3LfvCZUJchRIgxmrC8aaUqC16mPm6O0r_-_uPj3sZ-S8AAP__qxGGog) after being shot in the head during a church shooting in Minneapolis on Aug. 27. Doctors initially feared she wouldn’t survive, but Sophia is now stable and set to move from intensive care to a rehab program this week. Her mother, a pediatric ICU nurse, was on duty when her daughter arrived in critical condition. The family says she’s showing steady neurological progress, though the road ahead includes extensive therapy. A [GoFundMe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAUhZ9GOwxufpSCYhq7M-2UBHGjTFAM4DG-_c25uW9w-5W11vf9e5mXDTEc61-7o_arN9Unc-BdItaK2ewhW3fFdJWMLr0xP-GomMtpgIIgVBGQZrEhPka0i_aIgKxF3Q9iVP2g1NBuup_57EY_SsG9YJbP4LmUivXgRuaAt0F_2qgCCbRXQnbUDnZmSrBeCBi8aDjFJdSUu_8pHHVDH5_Pm86lvY16q_UsDfvTwNTAdN93tyZ_HcuOn0ADk29gKtd5plxJSecWLLHHQuqGxKfsNluIt3uID_nBbLNezjvEGIocGk7X3Yb4vVZ_remt4SsAAP__gDV_iw) supporting her care and recovery has raised over $1 million.
## Sister Pushed Brother to Finish Line
In Chippewa Falls, Wisconsin, Susan Bergeman [pushed her brother Jeffrey](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb2u3CAQRp8Gd7Pix4ApXKRxd9OmtFg8LCTYWDB7rX37yHmFVKc40miOvl9f65fPJR-vn37HOb7iSrGuB169IBG2dc_Nh3ep794w1G9sn3wQtn6ukksN3IE06-Zz-ax62OaIKFENOAurJyesc3ZIs3ATD25yMlodpJ60sdbIZxiNdsHbccjzfY07aSQXTpsH99Y_ldNKaC1t1GzkuGWq7fG75oMSxvK5v3mEug9lTkRnZ-oHkwuTy3Vdjz--oRC3ZnLxjXIoyORylzG5lBp8uemPDWoEwTnn0Km2jLcnxAOuVOF894QbJGzwbJVu5tsglpB8bpDyK0EPqdYCodXeIdT3Qe0DOyJBJ9-ow4EXhORPwsbkMjkYlVWjUgjGCg5jnEZw-hnBq00hNzo6NQ1t3s4rl5K7sWzkr93n8i-Y_nup71n-DQAA__9MD6hc), who has cerebral palsy, in his wheelchair during every high school cross-country meet. This spring, she pushed him across their graduation stage. Now in college, Susan runs in his honor while Jeffrey continues racing with their dad. Their story has fueled efforts to create official duo divisions in high school sports—giving more athletes like Jeffrey a chance to compete. [Watch a video report here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M9OxCAYBPCngds2_CmlHDiYmPW0mnhRT4SlH1sMLSv9uk3f3tRX8DqT_DKZj4u7-JTTfHv1E9h4iw5jcTNsSwZEqG5K1Yc1l3WpEMoD6p5mhLrcnWBCnZg5ic4NPuXdKTrYCCBAUrBcq95wbYymo22j4i1j0IPUnPed4qCFNzoweZVSDzTZQ2NGdIJxo7qGee2v0ijJlRI6KtIyGBKW2nyXNOMIMe_HmiaUiWY7It4XIp-IOBNx3rat2cuK6xWO_kg8hpHI84PI5_e3_nP9efnCKdBqh_uWck5Lp0nLbpNP-Y_Ef3_xsOI3AAD__7gkdBs). **😍 Watch this story and more come to life on the[ _Feel Good Flyover Podcast_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MGupCAUBNCvwV0buAg0CxaTdDqZRc92lgT10jJB6eBVx79_8f3C21YlJ5X6-_KvkHJa3n_CjC6-o6dY_ILHmpEIq59TDcOWy7ZWHMqO9UwLYV0_HjioG7c30H4MKZ9eNaOLiICyQSeMulthrDXN5JTV_V3EoRs4iq7rLGgdjTajtnfVR9kkd2ncggYurNItDyb00ioplAITFes4jolKbf-VtNCEMZ_XmnYoc5PdRPRZmfzF4MngeRxHe5aNth6v_koCDROTz53Jx_8q4Jj214N-M9DE5MPYtalu_Bwp57Rqwzr-nkPK3zj9-JXdwVcAAAD__yxGdt8) with Amy Hess.**
## Crow and Collie Strike Unlikely Friendship
After falling from a tree in June, [an injured wild crow](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrCAYhZ8GOwz8DCoFxW3s5rZbGpRfZRbBADPEt9-4r7Dtyck5X76v5_Q0zruw_TcH6nVbp7LGKWDNHkvBNB0umeXt4zsnXOIH0-VCwZTPCRhIyhSFbrLG-WuSjdUrIqBoUPNeDor3SvXNrgHZIJcZOCgh5sF2duA9MBT8IZQcROP0vcYUdMC4kl3LTG9moaTgUkK_SvJgaF2JqX1FF8qOq79umnaJR-P1XsqZifhHYCQw1lrbfMZvzIcJd4PAmEtMDjOB8X66AzwJjHwgMBpq40Z39CdaagJ14fVOaGl13tIlxUpDrLTseCWkM-ZCCYxN0vasznuXu5482HYY539xyp89fjT8BAAA__9ssYgQ) found an unexpected friend in a border collie named Meeko. The dog protected the crow, later named Russell, from cats and kept it company while it recovered in the family’s Portland yard. body:

DEVELOPING... the Trump administration is seeking to overturn a critical and
hard-won rule that balances the management of our beloved public lands. If they succeed, it would mean more oil and gas drilling and mining on our
public lands. Conservation, access to nature, and protection of wildlife habitat
will officially fall by the wayside. We are mobilizing NOW to prevent our country’s irreplaceable and treasured
public lands from being broken up and sold to polluters. We need your help: Right now, your renewed membership goes THREE TIMES as far to support our
campaign, thanks to a group of donors who have agreed to TRIPLE MATCH all
donations up to $50,000 through September 30. Will you renew now while your support counts 3X as much? Every $5=$15, through September 30 >> https://links.messages.lcv. Here’s what’s at risk: The Department of the Interior is proposing to roll back
the Bureau of Land Management’s Public Lands Rule — an important rule that
balances use of our public lands for conservation, wildlife habitat, watershed
management, land health, and cultural resources. This is yet another attack on
our public lands that prioritizes Big Oil and other corporate polluters when
making decisions about land use. The bureau oversees a whopping 245 million acres of land — and this move opens the door to more destructive drilling, mining, and logging operations on irreplaceable
landscapes and historical and cultural sites. The effects of this new policy could reverberate for generations. Please, renew your LCV membership for just $5 while your gift TRIPLES in impact to STOP this land grab from the Trump administration >> https://links.messages.lcv. RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP $5=$15 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/2zZrMNay0KC~ These lands belong to all of us. Their vast acres contain ancient petroglyphs
and cultural sites that make up the fabric of our nation’s history and
identities. They hold hiking trails, campgrounds, and once-in-a-lifetime
destinations where we gather to connect with nature and each other. These are the lands that make us us... and they belong to the people, not corporate interests. Yet, despite popular support, our public lands and national parks are in crisis.Mass layoffs and budget cuts have already left our national parks understaffed.
Critical projects and essential maintenance have been paused, even as
visitorship is up. Now, the Trump administration is stretching land management
even further in service of his dirty energy cronies. Our movement can win if we are united. We’re asking, Peter: please renew your membership for just $5 today to show your support for keeping public lands in public hands and do THREE TIMES as much to power our response. https://links.messages.lcv. We can’t do this without you. Thank you for all you do. Chris Brooks

Peter,
Breitbart just published a hit piece attacking me for telling the truth about the abuses ICE agents are committing under the Trump administration.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250926?refcode=em20250926-5473&refcode2=5473_420207_QRTVd9&akid=5473%2E420207%2EQRTVd9)
It’s not the first time the far right has come after me for speaking truth to power, and it won’t be the last.
This summer, Stephen Miller tweeted that I was in “open rebellion” against our country. Then, a White House spokesman called me “deranged” on national television. And just recently, the far right Twitter account “Libs of TikTok” tried to stir up outrage over our Resistance Lab grassroots trainings.
**Here’s the truth: The far right is counting on fear and smear campaigns to silence us.**
But I’m never going to stop fighting back, no matter WHAT the Trump administration or their propaganda outlets try to throw at me.
In moments like this one, the best way to fight back is to show them that their attacks will only make our grassroots movement stronger.

Peter, The end of the quarter is coming up in a matter of days. If you want to know why this quarterly fundraising goal is so critical, think about just how much has happened in the fight for a fair democracy since June. This moment requires scaling up to meet the demands of constant attacks on our democracy — our team has crunched the numbers, and it is vital that our team hits our goal to stay on track. [**In a moment, I’ll explain more about what we’re up against, but first, will you make a donation to help hit our quarterly fundraising goal?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116008070/572173670/1110433579?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_EOQLaunch1_email_20250926-NDRC-Tier1-EOQLaunch1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250926-NDRC-Tier1-EOQLaunch1_&utm_campaign=EOQLaunch1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY0ODZkYzI3LTIwOWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=YuH0MqlMDduXC-IC5xJI6GKd0lSXFi_hMlk0lae6aDA=) Here’s the situation we’re in. The Trump administration and its Republican allies have launched a coordinated attack on our democracy on multiple fronts:
* **Texas:** Republicans enacted an egregious, racially gerrymandered congressional map that diminishes the voting power of communities of color.

* **Missouri:** This month, lawmakers passed their own extreme gerrymander that would slice and dice Kansas City, depriving both urban and rural communities of fair representation.

* **Ohio:** The state is set to redraw its already-gerrymandered congressional map, and the GOP is eyeing as many as three seats to flip in their direction.

* **Indiana:** The White House and Donald Trump are pressuring state legislators to follow Texas and Missouri’s lead, despite growing bipartisan opposition. The Republican governor just said publicly that if they don’t go along with the White House’s plan, they could face “consequences.”

* **Louisiana:** The fair maps movement is headed to the Supreme Court in a case that will determine not just the future of Louisiana’s new, fair congressional map — but the future of the Voting Rights Act itself.

And that doesn’t even include the critical elections for Virginia’s governor and House of Delegates, and Pennsylvania’s state supreme court — all of which the GOP is spending big on to win. These unprecedented attacks on democracy and fair representation are a clear sign of why we need to scale up our efforts across the country. clean_body: | | | Team, When I knock doors and meet neighbors face to face, it’s clear what Coloradans really care about: access to health care, quality public education, rising grocery prices, tariffs, and the issues that affect everyday life. Yet when I look out at Washington, I see bankers, CEOs, tech moguls, and political pundits... but not many people who have had to rely on SNAP, Medicare, or public services. Instead, these concerns constantly get buried under divisive rhetoric. That motivates me as a grassroots candidate, but it also shows just how much we’re up against. ~~ | | ~~ We need leaders who truly understand the struggles of middle- and working-class families: teachers, blue-collar workers, skilled laborers, caregivers, and everyday people who know what works from experience. Our campaign for CO-4 is built on that principle. To keep the momentum going, we need to finish this quarter strong. We have a real chance to flip this seat blue, and expanding our grassroots network and reaching more voters can prove that the government can work for everyone. Friend, This week, one of the bombs funded by our country killed a Lebanese family of six with ties to residents of my district. **Our government must listen to the vast majority of Americans who want to stop funding deadly war crimes,** and instead use our taxpayer dollars to fund what our communities need to survive and thrive—like healthcare, housing, and food. At home and abroad, we must keep pushing to divest from state violence and invest in life. But it can take a long time for public pressure to move federal institutions like Congress. **Many U.S. activists are also pressuring U.S. corporations that are fueling genocide**. Thanks to this pressure, **Microsoft** revoked an Israeli military unit’s access to some of its storage and AI services, saying: “We do not provide technology to facilitate mass surveillance of civilians.”1 However, Microsoft has not ended its contracts with Israel’s military, police, prisons, illegal settlements, weapons companies, and the Israeli national water company that blocks Palestinians’ access to water. **Amazon** and **Google** also provide essential technology for the Israeli military and Israeli weapons manufacturers.2 And Google has an ads contract with Israel’s war criminal Prime Minister to spread disinformation about the forced famine and genocide in Gaza.3 By coming together, we can apply massive pressure to these tech companies to demand they end these contracts and help save millions of people’s lives. Many of my colleagues in Congress are trying to deny the truth and repress our movement, but they can’t silence us no matter how much they try. This week, **I submitted three documents into the Congressional record about the Gaza genocide** :
* The August 31st resolution from the International Association of Genocide Scholars—the world’s leading authority on the study of genocide—saying the Israeli government is engaging in “systematic and widespread crimes against humanity, war crimes and genocide.”4

* The September 16th report from the United Nations Commission of Inquiry that concluded the Israeli government is committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.5
* The names we have of every single child, mother, father, and grandparent killed in this genocide that has taken at least 60,000 lives. The first 21 pages are all children under the age of 1.6

I will keep demanding our government listen to the American people and stop supporting Israel’s apartheid regime, and I’ll keep pushing to ban members of Congress from owning stock in military corporations.
**While we continue pressing U.S. government leaders at all levels, we must also press the U.S. corporations enabling mass death.**
In addition to supporting Israel’s military, Amazon provides data storage for the Israeli agency that enforces apartheid policies and expands illegal settlements in the West Bank.7 Google and Amazon _also_ provide tech for the U.S. Department of Homeland Security to target, kidnap, detain, and deport immigrants. And Google provides AI for Lockheed Martin, the world’s largest weapons manufacturer.8

| | Hi, it’s Oregon Secretary of State, Tobias Read. Our democracy is being put to the test like never before. **There’s no sugarcoating it: I’m writing to you because the Trump administration just tried to seize control of Oregon’s voter registration data.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116008716/572175936/-569431239?refcode=250926em-data-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWE3NzE5My0yMzliLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7qkS69XfryqUiErXAT1lJn06MuFKtWKeCKoO7xUsrGU=)
---
They demanded voters’ personal identifying information that has no legitimate role in federal election oversight. Data that can be manipulated to undermine trust in our elections and go after opponents. **This demand has nothing to do with compliance and everything to do with power.** By hoarding personal data, Trump’s DOJ could spin false claims of voter fraud or even build a national voter database to target Americans. **I said no. As Oregon’s Secretary of State, I rejected their request in the strongest possible terms.** But I need your help to show that the people of Oregon stand with me. **[That’s why I’m asking you personally: Will you add your name to our petition opposing Trump’s voter data grab?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116008718/572175939/-120029677?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWE3NzE5My0yMzliLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7qkS69XfryqUiErXAT1lJn06MuFKtWKeCKoO7xUsrGU=&emci=fd6968fa-1a9b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=45a77193-239b-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=30662126)**

Peter, we've been trying to write this email for hours - it's hard to know what to say.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/e4503c77-c02b-478f-bb52-6109e7816204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **President Trump denied** having an "enemies list" but predicted more prosecutions of political opposers following former FBI Director James Comey's indictment, telling reporters Friday "I think there will be others" among what he called "corrupt radical left Democrats."
* **Former federal prosecutor Jim Trusty** explained that James Comey's indictment centers on **[allegedly lying to Congress about authorizing leaks to The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/b6c14a75-11a0-4c6f-9a96-67edabeea909?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** through a "special employee" designated specifically for that purpose, with Comey claiming under oath that he had "no recollection" of authorizing such leaks despite an Inspector General's report finding he had improperly retained and leaked classified memos.
* **Trump called the perjury case** against Comey a "pretty easy case" and justified potential future prosecutions by claiming his predecessors "weaponized the Justice Department like nobody in history."

# Democrats called out for hypocritical response to possible government shutdown
Senate Democrats, led by Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, **[refuse to provide votes needed to prevent a partial government shutdown](https://substack.com/redirect/d8ee9fe5-f45e-4ab8-9a03-686105be18c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by Sept. 30, despite supporting similar measures earlier this year when they feared mass federal employee firings under the Trump administration.
* **Flip-flop allegations** : Republicans accused Democrats of hypocrisy, noting they voted to keep government open in March over concerns Trump would have "carte blanche" to fire federal workers during a shutdown.
* **Mass firing memo** : The White House Office of Management and Budget this week directed agencies to conduct mass firings beyond typical shutdown furloughs, which Schumer dismissed as "an attempt at intimidation."
"Donald Trump has been firing federal workers since day one--not to govern, but to scare," **[Schumer said.](https://substack.com/redirect/eff58c22-c6b7-47e5-8faf-ddc58866a289?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

At the start of September, Justice Democrats endorsed Angela
Gonzales-Torres, our second 2026 Democratic primary candidate, in her race

Incumbent Rep. Jimmy Gomez got to Washington, DC, and closed the door
behind him. To advance his political career, he began prioritizing his
corporate, millionaire, and billionaire donors over the working-class
people back home in Los Angeles.

As Angie told The Los Angeles Times, “I think that Angelenos want to see
change. And what we are seeing is our current Congress member accepting
$2.3 million from AIPAC, then failing to co-sponsor the only bill calling
for a ceasefire. And what we are seeing is Jimmy Gomez taking, you know,
$500,000 from crypto lobbies, then voting to further Trump’s corrupt
crypto agenda.”

Angela, a true working-class champion, is taking Jimmy on to bring
unbought leadership to CA-34 that will fight back against Trump's fascism
with the urgency it demands and deliver REAL change for her community.

Taking on a powerful incumbent with the establishment and a
corporate-fueled war chest behind them is no easy feat. Progressives have
tried and failed to unseat Jimmy before — but this time, Justice Democrats
is getting in the race because we believe in Angie, and we know this
grassroots movement can overcome the onslaught of megadonor and super PAC
spending to send her to Congress.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250926?refcode=em20250926-37057&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=37057_1203867_C6Xga_&akid=37057%2E1203867%2EC6Xga_ ]Our work to elect Angie and other working-class progressives in 2026 is
ramping up day by day. As we approach the end of September and our
end-of-quarter deadline this Tuesday, can you rush $5 to
fuel our fight?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250926?refcode=em20250926-37057&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=37057_1203867_C6Xga_&akid=37057%2E1203867%2EC6Xga_ ]Contribute $5

Give me just a moment to explain why I’m asking for your donation today.
#
Peter, we’re about to face the first significant test of our campaign’s financial strength.
At the end of this month, we will be filing the first of our quarterly fundraising reports with the FEC.
You know what this means by now: Our opponent and his national Republican allies will soon see how much we’ve raised — they’ll see any drop in our fundraising numbers as evidence of weakness, and they’ll determine what they need to spend against us this fall and beyond based on that number.
**[Our end-of-quarter online goal is $555,000, and I’m reaching out personally to ask if you can start us off by splitting a donation of anything that is right for you between my team and Katie Porter today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250926_2_ak?refcode=em20250926-40197&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=40197_3422442_5s_C38&akid=40197%2E3422442%2E5s_C38)**
In recent weeks, the RNC made moves to start directing funds to our opponent even earlier than usual. This comes as no surprise — we’ve long known that our race could become the _most expensive_ U.S. Senate contest in history. The GOP is ready to commit any amount to defeating us.
The GOP machine can try to buy this seat, Peter, but I know that we can defeat them by standing together. **After all, we’ve won some of the toughest races in North Carolina before.**

I have been an upfront observer, participant, columnist, and commentator of Alabama politics for over six decades, and I can confidently say one of the most gifted political leaders in the history of our state is also one of its newest and youngest.

Katie Britt’s skills as a public servant and stateswoman were demonstrated beyond measure in a recent statewide poll that ranked her as the single most popular elected official in Alabama — more popular than even Kay Ivey or Tommy Tuberville.

It is easy to spot the ingredients in her recipe for success. Very few people ever have the complete package – but Britt has quickly proven to be a history maker.

U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) is working to revive one of the tenets of the American Dream, growing increasingly out of reach for many: Homeownership.

In a stark increase from the 1980s, when the average first-time home owner was in their late 20s, the average age of first-time home owners is 38 — an all-time high.

Now, Britt has made one of her legislative priorities bringing back what she calls the “hallmark of the American Dream.”

subject: Impeachment
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Haley Stevens for Senate
body:
Fringe conspiracy theorists should not be in charge of public health

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?&t=1&akid=969%2E49239%2EF68T8Q)
| | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/6446?t=2&akid=969%2E49239%2EF68T8Q)
---
Null,

I talk to Michiganders every day, and one thing keeps coming up over and over: People are scared.
They’re scared because the federal government’s approach to public health is guided by dangerous pseudoscience – causing endless chaos and confusion.
And it's because Donald Trump put a fringe conspiracy theorist in charge of public health.
Well, I’ve had enough.
**Yesterday, I announced I’m drafting articles of impeachment against Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Trump’s secretary of Health and Human Services.**
There might not be anyone more dangerous in Trump’s Cabinet right now.
RFK Jr. has fired the CDC director, leading to department-wide uncertainty. He’s purged essential government scientists and gutted research into cancer, HIV, addiction, and mRNA technology – research that saves lives and powers Michigan’s innovation economy. And he’s lied to members of the U.S. Senate under oath.
I called for his resignation earlier this month. **But when I saw him standing next to Trump, telling pregnant women not to take Tylenol – claiming, with zero proof, that it could cause autism – I hit my limit.**
Telling women to “tough it out” during pregnancy? Give me a break. That’s advice a middle school gym teacher gives when you get hit too hard with a dodgeball – not medical advice for a woman who is growing an entire human in her body.
It’s dangerous. It’s dishonest. And it’s disqualifying.
We need thoughtful leaders who put science over BS. Facts over conspiracy theories. People over politics. RFK Jr. has proven – over and over again – that he is not one of them.
And if he doesn’t like it? _Tough it out._
Thanks for standing on the side of science. Let’s keep fighting.
Haley
|

Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. body:
I’ll keep up this work — no matter how many Wawa runs it takes.
#
If you follow me on social media or read many of our emails, you probably know that I absolutely love coffee.
Especially when it comes from Wawa **(sorry, not sorry Sheetz)!**
[ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250926-1?refcode=em20250926-2368&amount=5&refcode2=2368_21716_2XMWmB&akid=2368%2E21716%2E2XMWmB)
While I take a quick coffee break, I wanted to reach out about something important: **we’re closing in on our FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, and it’s a big one.** And in addition to the coffee, I’m counting on your grassroots support to keep fueling this fight.
Because while folks keep asking me about cream and sugar, they're also talking about the real issues — like how to bring down the cost of housing and groceries, how to make childcare more affordable, and how to visit the doctor without breaking the bank. They want to know someone is fighting for them, as Donald Trump and corrupt DC Republicans rip us off and pad the pockets of billionaires.
That’s what I’m focused on every day in Congress. I’m showing up, speaking out, and fighting to make sure my neighbors and working families everywhere have a fair shot — no matter how many Wawa runs it takes!
**But here’s the truth: 2026 is around the corner — and after 9/30, I’m legally required to disclose our fundraising numbers publicly. Raising enough resources to post a strong report is essential to help me stay in Congress and build the coalition we need to take back the House.**
[**So if you’re with me, will you pitch in $5 or more before Tuesday’s fundraising deadline? We set an ambitious goal to raise $56,000, and I need your help to reach it!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250926-1?refcode=em20250926-2368&amount=5&refcode2=2368_21716_2XMWmB&akid=2368%2E21716%2E2XMWmB)

Sarah

name: Josh Harder
subject: Let me explain why this is so important
body:
No spin, no sugarcoating.
Hi Peter,
I always try to level with you — no spin, no sugarcoating.
**So here it is: I’ve never been in more danger than I am right now.**
That’s why I want to be clear about where we are, what’s ahead, and what I need from this team. [_**If you can rush in a donation right now to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal, I’ll leave a link here.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116011176/572183620/-704830606?&refcode=E15435-20250926-EOQExplainer-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQ1YjVhYmUtMmE5Yi1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5hDRaw3GQRj87kipw-S0DJGiIAQMp5NWiCa_uGmre1Q=)
**Where we stand:** I represent a Trump +2 district — one of only a handful of Democrats in the country doing so — and I’ve never hesitated to speak out against Donald Trump’s extreme, unconstitutional agenda. But that courage has put a giant political target on my back.
**What’s coming next:** National Republicans just put me at the very top of their target list. That’s a signal to Trump’s Super PACs and billionaire allies to unleash a wave of attack ads – and they’ve already spent millions of dollars. This deadline is our chance to prove we’re strong enough to fight back.
**What decisions we need to make:** Once this deadline passes, I’ll have to decide how much we can spend on digital ads so young people see the work Josh is doing to fight back. Latino organizing has also been one of the keys to our success — but we can only make those investments if we hit our fundraising goal.
**What I need from you:** I need your help to reach our goal. If we miss it, Republicans will pour even more money into this race and bury us early. The only way to stop them is to show our grassroots strength right now.
Will you please send in the biggest donation you can today to help us keep CA-09 blue? Here’s the link: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-Sept2025-FR-September?refcode2=Peter**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116011177/572183621/-704830606?&refcode=E15435-20250926-EOQExplainer-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQ1YjVhYmUtMmE5Yi1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5hDRaw3GQRj87kipw-S0DJGiIAQMp5NWiCa_uGmre1Q=)
If you made it to the bottom of this email, thank you — it means the world to me.
— Josh

Josh Harder for Congress

Manteca, CA 95337
United States

#

Peter,
Let me guess: when you open up your email inbox, you’re bombarded with emails from political campaigns or advocacy organizations, some of which you may not have even heard of.
I know it’s a lot. And it’s why in a sea of promises that “Donald Trump is FINISHED” and breathless “5X MATCH NOW!!!” emails, I work really hard to make sure our messages are different.
And the fact that you even opened this email gives me hope it’s working. Thank you.
Peter, if I could, I would wave a magic wand, overturn _Citizens United_ and get big money out of politics. Then I wouldn’t need to send these emails in order to fight back against the onslaught of right-wing Super PAC money.
But here’s the truth: almost all of the donations we receive come from people giving $10, $25, or $50 at a time — very often responding to emails like this one.
And while I certainly don’t expect you or anyone else to donate to every email my team and I send, I hope you’ll consider donating to this one.

body:
Up to and including weaponizing the federal government

| |
---
Friend, I wanted to make sure you saw this news. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116011319/572184167/1109339537?refcode=250927_ms_archivesl_p1&ms=250927_ms_archivesl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTU0MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGU3ZDg1M2UtMmM5Yi1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=lfFhPzN1B9VZbB_-WLTgWvhdzGXpjURzHlwfyiHosmA=) So they’re trying to take me down by undermining my record of service to this nation. But I’m proud of what I’ve accomplished: I saved a fellow midshipman’s life on a training exercise. | **Former FBI Director James Comey Faces Indictment ****[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=36158&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1pTlhGVXJBX1lKMCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=183d1dea50fdb408fcb6db6e910a0f51af86d360fc3d707ca54ebe3f81640db0)**Justice and accountability have finally moved forward with the indictment of former FBI Director James Comey on charges of making a false statement and obstruction of justice. Comey (in conspiracy with Hillary and Obama, helped launch smear campaigns and spy operations against the innocent Donald J. Trump) has been protected for far too long by a corrupt U.S. Department of Justice and FBI. Comey’s crimes are legion, but this indictment is one small step toward holding accountable those who engaged in the worst political abuse in the history of the country. More justice must come. In August, we [sued](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35947&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY29tZXktaW52ZXN0aWdhdGlvbi1vZi10cnVtcC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=416a83411f15fd7a601490c2303c510c6a3b889164a4f3311fb58ac99add8747) the Justice Department for all records regarding the FBI, under then-Director James Comey, initiating an investigation of then-2016 presidential candidate Donald Trump.In July 2019, we uncovered [FBI records](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35938&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtbmV3LWRvY3Mtc2hvdy1mYmktYWdlbnRzLXdlbnQtdG8tY29tZXlzLWhvbWUtdG8tcmV0cmlldmUtbWVtb3MvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=363ceae08b0f680ae5c80e13bf5cf4649179a5c4b7d1fc38e5334f4a6445dfbf), showing that in June 2017, a month after Comey was fired by President Donald Trump, FBI agents visited his home and collected “as evidence” four memos that allegedly detail conversations he had with President Trump.In August 2018, a federal court [ordered](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35939&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtY291cnQtb3JkZXJzLWRvai10by1wcmVzZXJ2ZS1jb21leS1wZXJzb25hbC1lbWFpbC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=b07c89cc8b3e213c098e813fbbe27ec3c1b353a26950ac0d9eafded5da8fc011) the Justice Department to preserve federal records located in Comey’s personal email accounts.In May 2018, [emails](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=27480&F=H&&hash=48cbe5d5f713a96cc549342d3d76df6a34bfff3b67a316918e283fba20d3f09e) we uncovered showed Comey was advised by FBI officials in May 2017 to consult with Special Counsel Robert Mueller prior to testifying before any congressional committees regarding Russian meddling in the 2016 presidential election and his firing as FBI director.In February 2018, in response to our [lawsuit](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZmJpLXdpbGwtcmV2aWV3LTE2NzUwLXBhZ2VzLWNvbWV5LWRvY3VtZW50cy1yZXNwb25zZS1qdWRpY2lhbC13YXRjaC1mb2lhLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=2ea899c3229861941bf20143ff8e584c72ca057efee0024c18fe2f77d2c59ad9), the FBI agreed to review [16,750 pages](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=6016&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnQtYXJjaGl2ZS9mYmktZm9pYS1yZXNwb25zZS0xNjc1MC1jb21leS1tZW1vLXJlY29yZHMtMjAxNy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=646b59f0c37fe0675b8162c3ee3aeb61519ccfd2b5fdbf9b37819da91e741f7b) of Comey’s records that were archived after he was dismissed.In January 2018, a [lawsuit](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35941&F=H&&hash=474495de55d04df837bb2d80a8666aee407e7c51bb31633f4d8620e1d4970a9b) we filed forced the FBI to turn over to the court for _in camera_ , non-public review former Comey’s memos allegedly detailing conversations he had with President Donald Trump.In November 2017, the Justice Department [compared Comey to Wikileaks](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35942&F=H&&hash=4ec2e4b807dce06f8a914efee903969cd03c5111105bd023f88ee0d70cded959). After Comey was fired by President Trump on May 9, 2017, he gave _The New York Times_ a February 14, 2017, memorandum written about a one-on-one conversation he had with President Trump regarding former National Security Advisor Michael Flynn.In June 2016, we sent Acting FBI Director Andrew G. McCabe [a warning letter](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35943&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZiaS1jb21leS1sZXR0ZXIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=f5bb4cd89f7a8293b6e7df6f6f8064fa7d4ecd25d3c5bdff89b19250fec22e82) concerning the FBI’s legal responsibility under the Federal Records Act (FRA) to recover records, including memos [Comey subsequently leaked](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76843&L=35944&F=H&&hash=195770eac886dc6b5ce2ea54df944d7f34be602811639ab6411e4e15bd0e38c7) to the media, unlawfully removed from the Bureau by Comey.

> The longstanding conflict between this Court’s interpretation of § 2 of the VRA [Voting Rights Act] and its Equal Protection Clause jurisprudence has run its course....The former mandates racial districting while the latter prohibits intentional racial classifications. For almost 30 years, courts and states have struggled to balance the conflicting mandates under [Supreme Court precedent] _Gingles_ and the Equal Protection Clause. The dividing of citizens by race, as required by _Gingles_ , is now doing more harm than good.
We argue that the proposed drawing of racial districts violates the 14th and 15th Amendments, that states “lack any interest, much less a compelling one, to create racial gerrymanders, even if done in a good faith effort,” and that Louisiana “impermissibly used race to create a second majority-minority district.”In our _amici_ brief, we recount:
> This Court has compared race-based districting to segregation of “public parks, ... buses, ... and schools,” and warned that we “should not be carving electorates into racial blocs.” ... That is because “[c]lassifications of citizens solely on the basis of race ‘are by their very nature odious to a free people whose institutions are founded upon the doctrine of equality.’” ... Racial gerrymandering, like all “[r]acial classifications of any sort” cause “lasting harm to our society” because “[t]hey reinforce the belief, held by too many for too much of our history, that individuals should be judged by the color of their skin.” ...
> There should be no question that race-based division of citizens for purposes of compliance with § 2 and _Gingles_ is a violation of the Equal Protection Clause, the “central purpose” of which “is to prevent the States from purposefully discriminating between individuals on the basis of race.”... The same may be said of the Voting Rights Act.

> Illinois counts mail-in ballots received up to two weeks after Election Day. Petitioners, candidates for federal office, claim that under controlling federal law that is two weeks too long. As a result, Illinois is counting unlawful ballots and producing inaccurate vote tallies, while simultaneously hurting petitioners’ prospects at the ballot box and injuring their pocketbooks. Everyone from the United States to the ACLU and the ACLJ agrees that petitioners have standing. Illinois disputes that remarkable consensus only by ignoring common sense (and the dangers produced by the Seventh Circuit’s rule) and by imagining non-existent waivers that did not deter the Seventh Circuit from denying standing because Congressman Bost’s electoral prospects were too bright and his pocketbook injuries too speculative.
We submit that the Seventh Circuit’s decision “is wrong and dangerous:”
> It is wrong because candidates have standing to challenge the rules that govern their elections, especially when their merits theory (which must be credited for standing purposes) is that the challenged rule produces an inaccurate final tally. At a minimum, the candidate has standing when (as here) he plausibly alleges that the challenged rule will harm his electoral prospects and reduce his bank balance because he needs to pay campaign staff an extra two weeks. And the decision is dangerous because it forces judges to play political prognosticators, skews standing rules to favor certain kinds of candidates, and funnels election disputes to the worst possible context—namely, after the election where judges are asked to declare political winners. This Court should reverse.
We assert that Congressman Bost has standing to challenge the Illinois law:
> At the very least, Congressman Bost has standing to challenge the Illinois ballot-receipt deadline here, as a host of diverse _amici_ confirm. Congressman Bost plausibly alleged a substantial risk that counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day will harm his electoral prospects both by risking electoral defeat and reducing his margin of victory. The plausibility of those allegations was amply reinforced by the Illinois Democratic Party’s attempted intervention and voting and litigation patterns nationwide. And he has also plausibly alleged a classic pocketbook injury because he expended additional campaign funds as a direct result of the state’s extended deadline for receiving mail-in ballots. Here too, the notion that an election artificially extended a fortnight costs more than one that ends on Election Day hardly strains credulity. The state’s contrary arguments lack merit.
